strings.(이름 모를 새의 울음 소리가 귓가를 간지럽힌다. 그리고 소리가 사라질: (An unfamiliar bird's song tickles the ear. As it fades, a warm breeze carries something small to the tip of the adventurer's nose.)
strings.(얼굴에 떨어진 작은 나뭇잎을 바라보던 %s의 옆으로 이리스가 다가와 살: (As %s looks at the little leaf that landed on their face, Iris approaches and gently meets their eyes.)
strings.(이리스가 놀라는 %s의 두손을 붙잡는다.): (Iris takes the startled %s's hands in hers.)
Don't worry. It's the morning after you fell asleep.
You've woken up startled for several days now...
strings.나도 놀라지 않으려고 해봤는데, 잘 안돼. 비그리드와 하이랜드에서 여러: I've tried not to, but I can't help it. I suppose it's everything that happened in Vigrid and the Highlands.
strings.조금이라도 쉬는 건 어때요?: Why don't you get a little rest?
You say that knowing perfectly well I can't.
That's the kind of person I am.
That's why I don't hide anything from you, %s.
I was surprised. I never imagined Hecate had visited while I was asleep...
strings.이리스, 이리스는 어떻게 하고 싶어? 평범한 사람으로 살 수 있다고 했잖: Iris, what do you want to do? She said you could live as an ordinary person.
strings.헤카테 님의 말씀이 진심인지 아닌지 잘 모르겠어요. 그게 진심이라 해도: I don't know whether Hecate meant what she said. Even if she did, it changes nothing.
strings.제게는 해야만 하는 일이 있어요. 세레스 님의 뜻을 이어 성계신이 된 자: I have a duty. I must carry on Seres's will and remain the God of the Astral Realm.
strings.언젠가 세레스 님이 다시 찾아올 그 날을 위해서라도…. 비록 헤카테 님을: For the day Seres returns... Even if that means making an enemy of Hecate.
strings.(이리스의 진심이 느껴져….): (I can feel how deeply Iris means that...)
strings.그런데 헤카테 님이 왜 나를 데려가려고 한 걸까?: But why did Hecate want to take me away?
strings.잘 모르겠지만, 안 좋은 예감이 들어요. 그게 절 인간으로 돌아가게 하는: I don't know, but I have a bad feeling about it. To make that the condition for returning me to human life...
Unless I choose to give up my role myself, that will never happen.
Please don't ask questions you already know the answers to.
strings.응, 알았어. 혹시 그거 말고 다른 말도 했었어?: All right. Did she say anything else?
strings.위대한 벽 사이를 보라고 하면서 떠나셨어요. 무슨 말인지 확인해 보니 그: Before she left, she told me to look between the Great Wall. When I checked what she meant, I saw that man.
Baral. The one who attacked us in Rosengarten and Avalon.
strings.마계의 문에서 나와 어디론가 가고 있는데, 바위가 가득한 산 사이에 커다: He came out through a gate to the Demon Realm and was heading somewhere. I saw a huge vortex among rocky mountains.
strings.거기가 어디지? 이젠 마계까지 갔다니. 무슨 일을 꾸미고 있는 지는 모르: Where could that be? Now he's been to the Demon Realm, too. Whatever he's planning, I have to investigate.
Yes. I don't know where it is yet...
strings.이리스, 내가 가서 정보를 모아볼게. 내가 거길 가야 이리스도 알 수 있: I'll go gather information, Iris. You can only learn more once I'm there, too.
strings.나 이리스에게도 하이랜드 식 인사를 하고 싶은데, 괜찮을까?: I'd like to give you the blessing they use in the Highlands. Would that be all right?
May Nornir bless your time with happiness, Iris.
strings.(그러면 어디로 가야 하지? 커다란 소용돌이가 있는 협곡…. 한 번도 들: (Where should I go? A canyon with a huge vortex... I've never heard of such a place...)
strings.(…아, 테오도르 교수님이라면 알고 계실지도…. 일단 가봐야겠다.): (...Oh, Professor Theodore might know. I'll try him first.)
strings.(에스닐 중심가의 카페 야외 테이블, 테오도르 교수가 커피 한 잔을 놓고: (At an outdoor café table in central Esnil, Professor Theodore repeatedly writes a name in his notebook, a cup of coffee beside him.)
strings.흐음, 이 이름을 내가 어디서 봤더라. 그 사람이 바로, 바로…. 어?: Hmm. Where have I seen this name before? That person was... was... Oh? %s?
strings.오랜만이군. 그동안 잘 지냈나?: It's been a while. Have you been well?
I have. So much has happened that I haven't had a chance to visit.
strings.괜찮아. 바쁘면 그럴 수 있지. 데이나와 시이나, 그리고 어르신께도 이야: That's quite all right. You've been busy. Dayna, Shiina, and my old mentor have told me a little.
strings.어르신, 아…. 자네도 알고 있는 헬레나 님이시지. 언제 처음 알게 됐는: My mentor... Ah, you know her, too. Helena. I can barely remember how long ago we met.
strings.꿈 많던 시절, 경험을 쌓으려 헬레나 님께서 이끄는 발굴단에 참여했다가: In my younger, more idealistic days, I joined an excavation team she led to gain experience. We've kept in touch ever since.
strings.인생의 스승님 같은 분이야. 그런데, 지금 내가 황녀님들의 스승 노릇을: She's been a mentor to me in life. And now I'm teaching the princesses myself. Strange how things turn out.
strings.자, %s. 그래서 무슨 일로 왔지? 날 찾아온 걸 보면 단순한 용무는: Now, %s. What brings you here? I suspect it's more than a casual errand.
There's somewhere I need to go, but I don't know where it is.
strings.혹시 바위가 가득한 산이나 언덕 가운데, 소용돌이가 계속 일어나는 장소를: Do you know of a place with a constant vortex among rocky mountains or hills?
strings.아…, 거길 말하는 건가?: Ah... Could you mean that place?
There's only one place with a vortex that large. Vayuna Canyon.
strings.바위와 버섯밖에 없는 협곡이었는데, 언제부턴가 소용돌이가 나타나 사라지지: It used to be nothing but rocks and mushrooms. Then one day the vortex appeared and never went away.
strings.희귀 버섯을 채집하러 갔던 사람들 말고도 그 소용돌이에 관심 있던 학자들: Besides people gathering rare mushrooms, scholars interested in the vortex have visited. But they haven't discovered much.
strings.종종 대륙 서부와 동부 사이에 마력이 소용돌이 형태로 일어나긴 하지만,: Magical vortices occasionally form between the western and eastern parts of the continent, but they're different from the one in Vayuna Canyon.
Hmm. I wonder if anyone's still researching it...
strings.고맙습니다, 테오. 그런데 거기로 가려면 어디로 가야 하나요?: Thank you, Theo. How do I get there?
strings.언젠가 자네가 나르샤와 함께 오르카리움에 다녀왔지? 거기서 남부 해안을: You went to Orcarium with Narsha once, didn't you? Follow the southern coast from there, and you'll find a path toward the canyon.
strings.최근에 의회 소속 병사들이 오르카리움에 배치됐다는 이야기를 들었네. 예전: I've heard the council recently stationed soldiers at Orcarium. Perhaps because of the earlier incident, or perhaps something else has happened...
strings.(분명 비그리드에 다녀온 후, 그 자리에 아론이 보이지 않았어. 혹시 그: (After I returned from Vigrid, Aaron was gone. Could that be why... ?)
strings.흐음, 제피로스에게 물어볼까?: Hmm. Perhaps I should ask Zephyros.
strings.제피로스? 한때 내 수업을 받은 제자긴 하지만, 지금은 마법청 소속이라…: Zephyros? He was once my student, but he's with the Magic Bureau now...
strings.그런가? 자네가 괜찮다면 괜찮은 거겠지. 그러고 보니 클로리스 학원장하고: Is that so? If you say so, I suppose it is. Come to think of it, he seems to be getting on well with Headmistress Chloris lately...
strings.그건 아니고. 클로리스가 학회 관련으로 찾아와 차를 같이 마신 적이 있는: No, but Chloris came to see me about an academic society matter, and we had tea...
strings.요즘 어떻게 지내냐고 질문했더니 엄청나게 부끄러워하더군. 괜찮아 보여서: When I asked how she'd been, she became terribly shy. She seemed well, though. I was glad of that.
strings.그나저나 자네도 알지 모르겠지만, 요즘 제국 사람들 사이에서 자네 이름이: By the way, you may already know this, but your name has been coming up often among people in the Empire.
strings.의회에선 좋지 않은 의미로, 일반 주민들에겐 다른 대륙에서 건너온 영웅으: The council speaks of you unfavorably. Ordinary citizens call you a hero from another continent. You're at the center of a great many rumors.
strings.만약 글래스턴에 가게 될 일이 있다면 부디 조심하게. 그리고 미안한데,: If you have reason to visit Glaston, be careful. And could I trouble you to take this book to Chloris on your way?
Of course. That's quite a thick book.
strings.제국 역사를 기록한 책이네. 클로리스 학원장이 이걸 못 구했는지 이야기하: A history of the Empire. Headmistress Chloris mentioned she couldn't find a copy.
I'm not sure why. I spotted it as soon as I entered the Belpha Library.
Thank you, Theo. I'll head to the Magic Academy, then. Goodbye.
strings.(테오도르가 모험가를 보내고 수첩에 적힌 이름을 다시 바라본다.): (After seeing the adventurer off, Theodore looks again at the name in his notebook.)
The first witch the Empire captured and executed as an example...
strings.(마법학원 제레니스의 학원장실 문 앞. 노크를 하기 위해 다가가려고 하는: (Outside the headmistress's office at Jerenis Magic Academy, a magical barrier blocks the adventurer's approach before they can knock.)
This should be nothing to you, %s. Yet you look surprised.
strings.(제피로스가 안경을 고쳐 쓰고는 마법서를 펼친다. 그러자 마법서 중심에서: (Zephyros adjusts his glasses and opens his spellbook. A small breeze rises from its center, stirring the magical barrier.)
strings.곧 학생들에게 중요한 시험이 있는데, 시험 관련 문서와 각종 기록들이 학: The students have an important exam soon. The exam papers and other records are in the headmistress's office, so I installed a security barrier.
strings.학사 일정이란 게 생각보다 신경 쓸 게 많다. 그건 그렇고 때가 되면 부: An academic calendar takes more work than you'd think. Anyway, I was going to send for you when the time was right... Has something happened?
strings.(그런 그때, 학원장실 안에서 클로리스의 목소리가 들려온다.): (Just then, Chloris's voice comes from inside the office.)
Um, you two... Don't stand out there. Come inside.
Let's do as Chloe says, %s. We can talk inside.
strings.(클로리스가 책상에 앉아있다가 제피로스와 함께 들어오는 %s의 모습을 보: (Chloris rises from her desk as %s enters with Zephyros.)
Hello, Chloris. You look busy again today.
That's work for you. Before you know it, it's snowballed into an avalanche.
strings.(클로리스의 투정을 빤히 보고 있던 제피로스가 조용히 손을 뻗는다. 그리: (Zephyros watches her complain, then quietly reaches out and pulls both her cheeks.)
strings.우아아아, 데, 데피, 디금 뭐하는 거디?!: Aaaah! Ze-Zeffy, wha' are you doin'?!
strings.(클로리스가 제피로스에게 지금 무슨 짓이냐고 하는 것 같다.): (Chloris seems to be asking Zephyros what he thinks he's doing.)
strings.정신 차려, 학원장님. 이러려고 학원장 자리 지키고 있는 건 아니겠지?: Pull yourself together, Headmistress. Surely this isn't why you held on to that position?
strings.(제피로스가 자신의 손을 뿌리치며 씩씩 대는 클로리스를 보며 가볍게 웃는: (Chloris bats his hands away and huffs. Zephyros chuckles, then offers her a small box he brought.)
You must feel cooped up, working in here all day. At least have something to eat while you work.
Remember the walnut pie you said you liked? I made one again. It's been a while...
strings.(클로리스가 놀라 상자 안에 있는 디저트를 살펴보고는 환한 미소를 보인다: (Chloris peers into the box in surprise, then breaks into a radiant smile.)
Sorry, %s. We got carried away talking to each other.
It's all right. Oh, Chloris, here. Professor Theo asked me to give you this.
strings.아, 이거. 제가 받으러 가야 하는데, 이렇게 가지고 오게 해서 미안해요: Oh, this! I should have picked it up myself. I'm sorry you had to bring it. I wasn't sure he'd be able to find it...
How did Professor Theodore get hold of that book...?
strings.교수님이 구해주신 거면 역사책이죠?: It's a history book, isn't it? Since the professor found it for you?
It concerns history, but it's no ordinary book.
strings.(클로리스가 조용히 고개를 끄덕이고 책을 펼친다. 그리고 페이지를 넘기며: (Chloris quietly nods and opens the book, turning the pages to show what is inside.)
strings.교수님 같은 분들이 보면 일반적인 역사 관련 서적으로 보이지만, 마력을: To someone like the professor, it looks like an ordinary history book. But anyone who can sense even a little magic will see these black pages.
strings.%s 씨의 눈에도 보이죠?: You can see them, too, can't you, %s?
strings.이야기가 좀 긴데…. 제국 기록원이라는 기관이 제국에서 일어나는 크고 작: It's a long story... An institution called the Imperial Archives records events in the Empire, great and small.
strings.일반적인 내용들은 마법학원, 현자의 탑, 제국 아카데미 같은 교육기관에서: The ordinary material is taught in schools such as the Magic Academy, the Tower of Sages, and the Imperial Academy, in classes and lectures.
strings.그러면 일반적인 내용이 아닌 것도 있다는 거네요?: Which means there's material that isn't ordinary, too?
strings.맞아. 빛이 있으면 어둠이 있듯이 역사도 마찬가지. 예를 들어 의회 소속: Exactly. History has its darkness as well as its light. Atrocities committed by council nobles, for example. Or an emperor who murdered his siblings to take the throne...
strings.초대 황제께선 혹시나 모를 일을 대비해 그런 내용은 필사원이 아닌 다른: As a precaution, the first emperor ordered those matters to be preserved by a means other than ordinary scribes.
Entrusting that work to ordinary people would put them in danger.
strings.대마법사 제레니스 님께서 벨파 도서관 사서 분들의 도움을 받아 절대 파기: With help from the Belpha Library's librarians, the archmage Jerenis created a book that could never be destroyed.
Once the scribes set down their accounts, spirits of record copied them into the indestructible book.
strings.책의 존재를 알게 된 악한 자들은 이 책을 없애려고 했지만, 쉽지 않았어: When those with guilty consciences learned of it, they tried to destroy it. But that was no easy task.
strings.지식의 신 그 자체인 벨파 도서관을 어지럽힐 수도 없고, 그 안에서 이: They couldn't interfere with the Belpha Library, which is the God of Knowledge itself. Even finding the book inside would have been difficult.
strings.그런데 교수님께선 어떻게 이 책을 찾으신 걸까요?: Then how did the professor find it?
strings.…지독한 책벌레에겐 책이 알아서 나타난다고 하던데, 정말 그런 것 같기도: ...They say books find their own way to a truly devoted bookworm. Perhaps it's true.
strings.어쨌든 나쁜 마음을 먹은 이들이 이 책을 찾은 적도 있는 것 같아. 그렇: In any case, some people with ill intentions apparently did find it. But even then, destroying it would have been difficult.
It's protected by a power ordinary magic can't even touch.
strings.결국, 어둠에 물든 자들은 그 내용을 다른 이들이 절대 볼 수 없게 이렇: In the end, those steeped in darkness blackened its pages like this, so no one else could read them.
There are so many black pages. What could they possibly contain...?
strings.우리가 상상할 수도 없는 그런 내용들이 많겠지만, 그중에서도 내가 확인하: A great deal beyond our imagination, I'm sure. But there's one part I want to check.
An early director of the Magic Bureau who retired in disgrace, long ago...
strings.잠깐만요, 제피로스. 검은 페이지를 쉽게 보려면 엄청나게 많은 마력이 필: Wait, Zephyros. Wouldn't reading the black pages take an enormous amount of magic...?
We have the Windy Seed, so we'll be fine. It won't be dangerous.
As long as you don't merge with the Windy Seed like last time...
strings.아니에요!! 이번엔 학교 안 부술 거라고요!!: I won't! I'm not going to destroy the school this time!
I'm sorry, %s. Work must be getting to me lately.
Phew. This won't do. You need a break.
strings.(제피로스가 짧게 한숨을 쉬고는 상자에 있던 호두 파이 한 조각을 꺼내: (Zephyros sighs, takes a piece of walnut pie from the box, and puts it into Chloris's mouth.)
strings.(이어 %s에게도 호두 파이 한 조각을 작은 접시에 담아 건넨다.): (Then he puts another piece on a small plate and hands it to %s.)
Ahh, it's so good. Your pies are the best, Zephy.
strings.내가 유일하게 할 수 있는 거라 맛없게 하는 것도 힘들 거야. 어머니의: It's the only thing I can make. I'd have to try hard to get it wrong. I don't want to ruin my mother's recipe.
Your mother must have been a wonderful cook. It's delicious.
strings.어머니가 돌아가시기 얼마 전에도 이 파이를 만들어주셨었는데…. 아, 이: She made this pie for me not long before she passed away... Ah, this isn't the time for that story.
strings.(클로리스가 두손으로 눈을 가리고 아무렇지도 않은 척한다.): (Chloris covers her eyes with both hands and tries to act unaffected.)
strings.%s 씨, 저 아무렇지 않죠?: I look perfectly fine, don't I, %s?
strings.다행이다. 헤헤. 그런데, %s 씨. 책만 가져다주려고 온 건 아니죠?: Good. Hehe. But %s, you didn't come just to deliver the book, did you? You look as though you have something else to discuss...
I was about to check the book anyway. Good timing. Stay and listen.
strings.들어도 되는 건가…. 그런데 책 내용을 여기서 확인해요? 학원장실에서 마: Am I allowed to hear this...? And you're going to read it here? Is it safe to use magic in the headmistress's office?
It's fine, %s. This room is safer than it looks...
All we need to do is place our hands on the book.
You can thank the Windy Seed.
strings.(제피로스가 책을 살펴보다 원하는 페이지로 생각되는 부분을 펼친다. 그리: (Zephyros searches the book and opens it to the page he wants. He takes Chloris's hand and places it on top.)
strings.(그러자 작은 나뭇잎들이 따뜻한 바람과 함께 나타나 두 사람의 손 위로: (Small leaves appear on a warm breeze and settle over their hands.)
That seemed more like a spirit's power than magic.
That's a fair way to put it.
strings.(클로리스와 제피로스가 책의 페이지에 놓인 나뭇잎을 치우자 검게 칠해져: (Chloris and Zephyros brush the leaves from the page. The blackened sections are now white.)
...Here's the part I wanted. Let me read it.
strings.「3대 마법청장 크롤리는 대마법사 제레니스의 제자였지만, 스승이 세상을: “Crowley, the third director of the Magic Bureau, was a pupil of the archmage Jerenis. However, he clashed with his teacher repeatedly until Jerenis's death.”
strings.「제레니스가 다른 종족들과 함께할 미래를 꿈꿨지만, 크롤리는 철저하게 제: “While Jerenis dreamed of a future shared with other races, Crowley pursued a future centered entirely on the Empire.”
strings.「제레니스가 세상을 떠나고 몇 년 뒤, 의회의 승인 아래 수인 제국 크리: “Several years after Jerenis's death, part of the beastfolk empire of Creed was annexed by the Empire with the council's approval.”
strings.「제국의 피해는 적었다. 수인왕을 비롯해 일부 수인 수백이 행방불명되는: “Imperial losses were light. The disappearance of the Beastman King and several hundred of his people kept conflict to a minimum. Their whereabouts remain unknown.”
strings.(잠깐만…. 미노스 님하고 파시파에 님이 갇힌걸, 행방불명됐다고 한 거야: (Wait... They described Minos and Pasiphae's imprisonment as a disappearance?)
strings.「이 과정에서 크롤리가 공을 인정받아 마법청의 주요 보직을 맡는다. 그리: “Recognized for his achievements in this operation, Crowley received a senior position in the Magic Bureau. When the second director later retired, Crowley naturally succeeded him as the third.”
strings.「의회는 그동안 잠잠했던 마녀들이 나타나 주민들을 해한다는 상황을 파악한: “The council learned that witches, long inactive, had begun to appear and harm the populace. A motion was proposed and approved.”
strings.「마녀사냥이 시작된 그해, 첫 번째 마녀가 처형당했다.」: “The first witch was executed in the year the witch hunt began.”
strings.다음 부분은 혼돈의 하늘 이후 제국이 어떻게 변했나 정도가 적혀 있는데: The next section describes how the Empire changed after the Sky of Chaos. Then...
strings.「3대 마법청장 크롤리가 고대의 금서에 손을 댔다는 이유로 불명예스럽게: “Crowley, third director of the Magic Bureau, retired in disgrace after dabbling in an ancient forbidden tome. Following his retirement, he established a private magic research institute.”
strings.제가 아는 그 사설 마법 연구소 맞는 건가요?: Is that the private magic research institute I know?
strings.미르간디아에 주둔하고 있던 용병단을 이용해 공포 실험을 하려고 했던 그: Yes. The one that tried to use the mercenaries stationed in Mirgandia for experiments on fear.
strings.한때는 번창해서 3연구소까지 있었지만, 지금은 2연구소만 남아있어. 마법: It once prospered enough to have three institutes. Now only the second remains. It handles work the Magic Bureau doesn't undertake.
On the surface, that work appears to benefit the public, but...
strings.이 기록을 보니 확실한 것 같아. 크롤리가 손댄 금서의 내용과 사라진 크: These records seem to confirm it. The contents of Crowley's forbidden tome, and the missing people of Creed...
strings.이제 다른 증거를 또 찾아야 해. 지금도 어딘가엔 남아있을 거야. 후우…: We need more evidence. There must still be some somewhere. Phew...
Let's look together. We have to uncover the truth.
strings.제피로스, 아직도 마법청 소속이죠?: Zephyros, you're still with the Magic Bureau, aren't you?
strings.아직 쫓겨나진 않았어. 하지만, 곧 그렇게 될 수도 있겠지. 마법청 소속: They haven't expelled me yet. Though they may soon. If you're asking about my position, it must matter...
strings.(제피로스에게 간단하게 바유나 협곡에 가야 하는 이유를 설명한다.): (I briefly explain to Zephyros why I need to visit Vayuna Canyon.)
strings.(제피로스가 고민하는 것 같더니 조용히 클로리스를 바라본다.): (Zephyros thinks for a moment, then quietly looks at Chloris.)
Chloe... No. Headmistress, I'd like to take some leave.
Now? Wait, no. If you're going, I'm coming with you. This time...
Headmistress Chloris, what will you do if the academic schedule falls apart?
strings.(제피로스가 클로리스의 앞에 잔뜩 쌓여있던 서류 더미들을 가리킨다.): (Zephyros points to the stacks of papers piled in front of Chloris.)
Cruel? This is always the headmistress's busiest time of year.
Don't worry too much. You know what's near Vayuna Canyon...
I know. I know what that place means to you... How can I say no when you put it like that?
All right, go. Take care. I hope everything is all right back home.
strings.(클로리스가 쓸쓸한 미소를 보였지만, 다시 밝게 웃으며 제피로스를 안는다: (A wistful smile crosses Chloris's face. Then she brightens and embraces Zephyros.)
strings.마법청 소속인 걸로 도움을 좀 받으려고 했는데, 같이 가게 될 줄은 몰랐: I only hoped your position at the Magic Bureau might help. I didn't expect you to come along.
strings.마법청 눈을 피해 오르카리움으로 가는 것도 방법이긴 한데, 좀 더 안전하: We could slip into Orcarium without the Bureau noticing, but let's take a safer route.
strings.이건 마법청 소속 마법사로서도, 마법학원 이사장도 아닌 고향을 찾는 단순: That's my suggestion as someone visiting home, speaking neither as a Bureau mage nor as chairman of the academy.
strings.단순한 귀향객이라. 하핫. 그래서 어디로 가야 하는 거죠?: Just someone visiting home, hmm? Haha. So where do we go?
The Nereis Gateway. There's someone there who can help.
...Phew. Finally finished. Perhaps I can catch my breath and rest a little.
strings.(노토스가 네레이스 관문 센터 앞에서 기지개를 켜고는 멍하니 하늘을 바라: (Notos stretches outside the Nereis Gateway Center and gazes absently at the sky. A breeze tickles his nose.)
It's been a while since the wind blew from the west at this hour.
strings.(작은 새 여러 마리가 지저귀며 노토스 앞으로 날아와 앉는다.): (Several small birds flutter down in front of Notos, chirping.)
strings.어, 협곡에 있어야 할 새들이 왜 여기까지 날아온 거지?: Hm? What are birds from the canyon doing all the way out here?
strings.아, %s 님. 오셨습니까? 안 그래도 [위대한 %s의 방]을 청소했는데: Ah, %s. Welcome. I've just cleaned the [Chamber of the Great %s]...
strings.(노토스가 %s 옆에 서있는 사람의 얼굴을 보더니 잠시 말을 잇지 못한다: (Notos notices the person beside %s and falls silent.)
strings.[위대한 %s의 방]? 대체 그 방 이름은 왜 그런 거지?: The [Chamber of the Great %s]? Why in the world is it called that?
It is a distinguished name bestowed by Her Majesty.
Oh, really? A name from Her Majesty herself. That does make it special.
Aagh, please stop talking about that room. It's embarrassing...
Anyway, it's been a long time, little brother.
strings.(제피로스가 노토스에게 다가가는 순간, 항상 웃고 있던 노토스의 눈매가: (As Zephyros approaches, the ever-smiling Notos's eyes suddenly narrow.)
Ugh... A punch without so much as a warning.
strings.(노토스가 만족스러운 표정을 지으며 쓰러진 제피로스에게 손을 뻗는다.): (Looking satisfied, Notos offers the fallen Zephyros a hand.)
Up you get, little brother. As far as I'm concerned, that settles everything I've been holding against you...
strings.(제피로스가 노토스의 손을 붙잡고 일어나는 척하더니 그대로 어깨로 들이받: (Zephyros takes Notos's hand as though to get up, then rams his shoulder into him. Notos stumbles backward and falls.)
strings.…이 자식. 감히 형한테, 해보자는 거냐?: ...You little brat. Is that how you treat your older brother? You want a fight?
strings.내가 당하고만 있을까 봐? 겨우 2분 차이면서 형 소리가 그렇게 듣고 싶: Did you think I'd just take it? You're only two minutes older. Do you need to hear me call you big brother that badly?
strings.그럼 어디 해보자고!! 내 동생!!: Then let's have it, little brother!
strings.(노토스와 제피로스가 서로를 향해 달려들려고 하는 순간, 작은 새들이 말: (Just as Notos and Zephyros are about to charge, the little birds fly between them as if trying to break up the fight.)
strings.(새들이 한바탕 노토스와 제피로스 주위를 휘젓고는 멈춘다. 그러더니 시끄: (The birds swirl around the brothers, then stop and begin chirping loudly again.)
You know these birds, Notos. They're too timid to fly from west to east. So why are they here...?
strings.협곡에 무슨 일이 있긴 한 건가?: Has something happened in the canyon after all?
As it happens, I need to go there.
That's why you've come with %s. My apologies, %s.
strings.제가 오랜만에 동생을 봐서 너무 반가운 나머지, %s 님께 결례를 범했네: I was so delighted to see my brother after so long that I forgot my manners, %s.
strings.이해해 주신다니 감사합니다. 그러면 제피로스와 함께 절 찾아오신 이유를: Thank you for understanding. Could you tell me why you've come to see me with Zephyros?
strings.(노토스에게 바유나 협곡에 가야 하는 이유를 간단하게 이야기한다.): (I briefly explain to Notos why I need to visit Vayuna Canyon.)
So we need to go to Vayuna Canyon.
strings.(노토스가 고민하는 것 같더니 멀리서 순찰을 끝내고 돌아오는 에담을 부른: (Notos considers this, then calls to Edam, who is returning from a patrol in the distance.)
Edam, I'm going to take some leave.
strings.(형제 둘 다 갑자기 휴가 내겠다고 상대를 놀라게 하네.): (Both brothers spring a sudden leave request on someone.)
strings.오랜만에 동생이 찾아와서 잠시 고향에 다녀와야 할 것 같습니다. 정확히는: My brother has come to visit after a long time. I think we should make a brief trip home. Near home, to be precise.
strings.(에담이 제피로스를 보더니 알겠다는 듯 고개를 끄덕인다.): (Edam looks at Zephyros and nods in understanding.)
Please take care of the Nereis Gateway until I return.
strings.네, 알겠습니다. 그러면 언제 떠나실 예정입니까?: Of course. When will you be leaving?
As the saying goes, ride the wind when it blows. I'll leave now.
Now? We're in the middle of the gateway's intensive inspection period...
strings.이미 상부에 보낼 서류 검토 및 게이트 점검도 모두 끝냈습니다. 나머지는: I've already reviewed the reports for our superiors and finished inspecting the gates. You can handle everything that remains.
You've done all that already? That's impressive.
(After discussing work with Notos, Edam heads inside the Center.)
That's settled with Edam... Shall we go, %s?
Notos, I didn't ask you to come with us.
strings.제피로스, 바유나 협곡으로 안전하게 가려고 날 찾아온 거잖아. 제국 시설: Zephyros, you came because you wanted a safe route to Vayuna Canyon. You wanted the gateway officer to let you use an imperial facility for private purposes.
strings.청탁이라니…. 말이 왜 그런 거야?: Pulling strings...? Why put it like that?
Be quiet and follow me before I change my mind.
strings.(노토스가 제피로스의 어깨를 두드리고 가볍게 미소 짓는다. 그리고는 게이: (Notos pats Zephyros's shoulder with a faint smile, then leads the way to the gates.)
Ahaha... Come on, Zephyros. Let's go to the gates.
strings.(왠지 모르게 오늘따라 노토스 님 미소가 사악해 보이네….): (For some reason, Notos's smile looks positively wicked today...)
strings.(노토스가 개방되지 않았던 게이트 앞에 다가가 이리저리 살펴본다.): (Notos approaches a gate that has not been opened and inspects it.)
This one should do. The surrounding magic is stable, and the gate is in good condition...
This is just how I look.
strings.나와 똑같은 얼굴로 그런 표정은 좀 피해줄래?: Could you avoid making that face when it's identical to mine?
strings.이 많은 게이트 중에서 하나는 센터장 권한으로 마음대로 쓸 수 있으니까: As Center Director, I'm entitled to use one of these gates at my discretion. Stop worrying.
strings.그런 거였군요. 어쩐지…. 노토스 님 말씀대로 이 게이트를 사용하면 되겠: Oh, I see. That makes sense... We can use this gate, then.
We can use it immediately, but there is one small issue.
strings.바유나 협곡에 흐르는 마력 정보가 오랫동안 갱신되지 않아서 정확한 지점에: The magical readings for Vayuna Canyon haven't been updated in a long time. We may not arrive at the exact destination.
strings.사람들이 방문하는 장소에는 알게 모르게 마력들이 모여 있습니다. 게이트는: Magic gathers wherever people visit, whether they know it or not. The gate detects that gathered magic and sends travelers to it...
strings.바유나 협곡같이 사람들이 잘 찾지 않는 곳은 게이트를 이용해도 정확히 도: So when you use a gate to reach somewhere rarely visited, like Vayuna Canyon, an accurate arrival is less likely.
strings.설마 바다 가운데로 떨어지진 않겠죠?: We won't end up in the middle of the sea, will we?
We won't land somewhere without a path.
Though we may have a little farther to walk...
strings.(주황빛 작은 새들이 노토스와 제피로스의 주위를 날아다닌다. 그중 몇 마: (The little orange birds flutter around Notos and Zephyros. A few settle on their shoulders.)
How curious. They come right up and perch on you without any fear...
strings.어릴 때 생각이 조금 나네요. 집 앞에 나오면 항상 이 새들이 우리 형제: It reminds me of our childhood. Whenever we stepped outside, these birds would flutter around us.
Then Mother would give us something to feed them...
It sounds like a place with happy memories.
strings.어머니가 돌아가시고, 아버지와 함께 글래스턴으로 가게 됐는데…. 아버지께: After our mother died, we moved to Glaston with our father. Then Father, too...
With both Zephyros and me here, you needn't worry, %s.
Ahaha... I do feel better knowing you're both coming.
strings.(또 싸울까 불안하지만….): (Though I'm worried they'll start fighting again...)
strings.(노토스가 먼저 게이트 안으로 발걸음을 옮기자, 뒤를 이어 제피로스가 들: (Notos steps through the gate, followed by Zephyros.)
It's strange seeing the two of them together. They're brothers, though. I'm sure it'll be fine...
strings.(새의 지저귐과 함께 게이트에 실려있던 마력의 흐름이 흩어진다. 그리고: (Birdsong rings out as the gate's currents of magic disperse. A bright light washes over the adventurer, then fades to reveal a new landscape.)
strings.(하늘이 닿을 정도로 높은 위치에 있던 바위가 방문객에게 커다랗고 웅장한: (Towering rocks, high enough to touch the sky, cast vast, majestic shadows over the visitors.)
strings.(제피로스가 도착한 장소의 풍경에 말을 잇지 못한다.): (Zephyros is speechless at the sight of where they have arrived.)
I expected to arrive near the canyon, but not here.
strings.%s 님, 저기 작은 집 보이십니까?: %s, do you see that little house?
It's where we lived with our parents as children.
strings.부모님의 마법 도구가 아직 집에 남아있어서 게이트의 마력이 우리를 이곳으: Our parents' magical tools are still inside. Perhaps their magic drew the gate here.
strings.그 일 이후, 여기가 처음이지?: Your first visit since it happened?
strings.마법청을 떠나고 며칠 후에 왔었어. 네가 나와 클로리스에게 모질게 굴었던: I came a few days after leaving the Magic Bureau. I couldn't understand why you'd treated Chloris and me so harshly.
I stopped here to gather my thoughts and pack a few things before going to the Tower of Sages. It's already been years. Three? Four?
strings.3년이든, 4년이든 그게 중요한 게 아니야. 그 시간 동안 밝혀낸 것들을: Three or four, it doesn't matter. Tell me what you've uncovered in that time.
What the Magic Bureau was plotting...
strings.잠깐, 내가 어떻게 할지 알고 있었어?: Wait. You knew what I was doing?
You made it that obvious and expected me not to notice? Phew...
There's a limit to how foolish you can take your own twin for. Even our souls are alike.
I'm sorry. All right. I'll tell you.
Good. And you can keep being sorry while you explain.
strings.(두 사람, 서로에 대한 믿음이 있었던 거네….): (They believed in each other all along...)
strings.(제피로스가 노토스에게 그동안 조사했던 것들을 이야기한다.): (Zephyros tells Notos what he has learned in his investigation.)
I see. You've been through a lot, little brother...
It wasn't so bad... It's just...
Don't blame yourself. Now, let me tell you my side.
strings.내가 현자의 탑으로 간 건, 아버지의 연구 자료를 찾기 위해서야. 아무리: I went to the Tower of Sages to find Father's research. Even the Magic Bureau can't lay hands on the Tower.
strings.아버지가 젊었을 때의 목표 알고 있지?: You remember what Father wanted when he was young?
For magic to serve everyone, instead of belonging to mages alone.
strings.그래서 특기인 바람 마법에서 바람의 흐름을 읽어 그 마력을 모아 하나의: So he used his specialty, wind magic, to read the wind's currents and gather their magic into a crystal.
strings.그 결정을 이용하면 일반 주민들도 마력이 필요한 도구나 기계, 시설을 쉽: With that crystal, ordinary people could easily operate tools, machines, and facilities that require magic.
strings.…잠깐만요, 노토스 님. 이런 경우를 어디서 본 거 같은데…. 설마, 루: ...Wait, Notos. I've seen something like that... Luria Village?
strings.맞습니다, %s 님. 시범적으로 루리아 마을에서 운영하다 점차 퍼지게 됐: Exactly, %s. It began as a trial in Luria Village and gradually spread.
That was Father's research? I had no idea...
strings.아버지가 마법청에 가셨을 땐, 그 연구로 주민들이 더 나은 생활을 하길: When he went to the Magic Bureau, he must have hoped his work would make people's lives better.
The people of Luria Village seemed happy with it.
If there's nothing more to it, that's good...
strings.폐하를 비롯해 황녀님께서 자주 찾는 마을이라 마법청도 쉽게 건들 수는 없: Her Majesty and the princess visit often, so the Magic Bureau can't easily interfere. But we should still be careful...
strings.(갑자기 작은 새들이 그들의 옷깃을 물고 앞으로 날려고 버둥댄다.): (Suddenly, the little birds seize their clothes in their beaks and flutter forward, tugging insistently.)
They seem to want us to go somewhere... Wait. Notos, %s, look over there.
strings.(제피로스가 가리킨 방향, 협곡 중심에 있던 바람의 소용돌이가 커다란 소: (Where Zephyros points, the vortex at the canyon's center roars, repeatedly swelling and shrinking.)
I've never seen it do that before...
strings.…우리가 여기서 본 소용돌이는 언제나 편안한 느낌이었는데, 오늘은 다르군: ...The vortex we knew always felt peaceful. Today it's different. There's a menace to it, sharp as a blade...
strings.일단 제가 온 목적은 이곳에 무슨 일이 일어나는지 확인하는 거예요. 두: I came to find out what's happening here. It could be dangerous, so you two should stay.
strings.가만히 있으려면 여기 오지도 않았을 겁니다. 일단 온 이상, 뭐라도 할: If I intended to stand around, I wouldn't have come. Now that I'm here, I mean to help.
We came together. Don't even think about handling this alone.
If you're both that determined... All right. I'll ask you to guide me, then.
strings.바유나 협곡이 험하긴 하지만, 정해진 길로만 가도 소용돌이를 피해서 잘: Vayuna Canyon is rugged, but if we follow the established paths, we can avoid the vortex and get through safely.
strings.어릴 적, 노토스하고 협곡을 돌아다니면서 놀곤 했거든. 웬만한 길은 다: Notos and I used to play all over the canyon. We know most of the paths. Just follow us.
strings.버섯나무 늪지 앞까지 가보는 건 어때?: Why don't we head to the edge of Mushroom Tree Swamp?
strings.거긴 어떤 곳이죠?: What sort of place is it?
A place with rare mushrooms, and monsters that live on them.
strings.그렇군요. 그러면 늪지 앞까지 가볼까요?: I see. Shall we head to the swamp, then?
strings.아, %s 님. 제피로스와 먼저 가시죠. 저는 잠깐 집에서 물건을 챙겨서: Oh, %s. Go ahead with Zephyros. I'll get a few things from the house and catch up.
All right. We'll go on ahead.
We'll wait for you there, Notos. Oh, he's already inside.
Zephyros, wait right there. No running away this time.
Phew. I said I would. Come on, %s.
strings.(버섯나무 늪지 앞에 도착한 제피로스가 자신을 쫓아온 몬스터를 쓰러뜨리고: (At the edge of Mushroom Tree Swamp, Zephyros defeats a monster that chased him and sighs.)
strings.후우…. 확실히 이상하네. 전에는 없던 몬스터도 나타나고, 마족이 나타난: Phew... Something is definitely wrong. Monsters that weren't here before, traces of demons...
Even the birds called Sylphins seem to be attacking us.
Though these ones that followed us from the Nereis Gateway seem to be protesting...
He must be nearby. Hmm... Speaking of that man.
strings.검성이라 불리는 초인 지스카드 님의 제자였다가 타락했고, 마계에도 드나들: A fallen pupil of Lord Ziskad, the demigod known as the Sword Saint. Visiting the Demon Realm, helping summon the Twisted One in Eastland...
I don't know for sure. My guess is that he wants to become a demigod.
strings.대충 알 것 같은 인물이군. 힘을 원하지만, 단순한 힘만으로는 만족하지: I think I understand the type. He wants power, but ordinary power will never satisfy him.
strings.만족할 만한 힘을 얻을 때까지는 멈추지 않을 거야. 더는 멈출 수도 없을: He won't stop until he has enough to satisfy him. Perhaps he can't stop anymore.
strings.(누군가 강제로 멈춰야 한다면….): (If someone has to force him to stop...)
strings.안 그래도 프레이오스 대륙이 마계와 연결된 문들이 많아서 원하는 걸 딱: With so many gates connecting Freios to the Demon Realm, he's well placed to find what he wants.
strings.이건 중요한 이야기가 아니니까 나중에 하고. %s, 여기가 버섯나무 늪지: But that can wait. %s, this is the path to Mushroom Tree Swamp.
strings.(제피로스가 가리킨 방향에 다양한 색의 커다란 버섯들이 하늘을 향해 서있: (Where Zephyros points, enormous mushrooms of many colors rise toward the sky.)
...Mushrooms growing as tall as trees. It feels a little strange...
strings.그래? 노토스하고 나는 어릴 때 저기서 놀아서 그런지 몰라도 그냥 버섯이: Does it? Notos and I played there as children. To us, they're just mushrooms.
I was surprised when I learned people called them mushroom trees.
I see. Oh, Zephyros, here comes Notos.
(The little orange birds seem to notice, too, and fly toward Notos in greeting.)
strings.전에 집에 왔을 때, 아버지가 남긴 메모 중에 이상한 말이 적혀 있었던: I remembered something strange in a note Father left, from my last visit... So I brought something of his.
strings.협곡에서 어려운 일이 생기면 마력으로 봉인된 상자에서 물건을 꺼내 가라고: He said that if there was ever trouble in the canyon, we should take the object from the magically sealed box.
strings.(노토스가 제피로스와 %s에게 파란빛으로 맴도는 작은 결정을 보여준다.): (Notos shows Zephyros and %s a small crystal surrounded by blue light.)
strings.이걸 챙겨서 협곡으로 올라가려고 하는데, 어디선가 나타난 리자드맨이 날: I was about to head into the canyon with it when a lizardman appeared and chased me. Dealing with it took some doing.
Phew. But when I moved this stone, the barrier around the house weakened. Father's magical tools must have been keeping the house safe all this time.
strings.어쩐지. 사람 살지 않는 빈집이 없어지고도 남을 시간이었는데, 지금까지: That explains it. An empty house should have fallen apart long ago. There was a reason it's still standing.
Wait... Now that I look at it, the power in that spirit stone...
strings.%s 님, 혹시 이 정령석에 담긴 힘이 느껴지십니까?: %s, can you feel the power in this spirit stone?
A little. Is that wind energy...?
(As %s studies the stone, the little bird's cry rings in their ear. Turning in surprise, they meet an unwelcome gaze at the entrance to Mushroom Tree Swamp.)
I expected you to come here. I didn't think we'd meet so soon.
strings.(바랄의 시선이 자연스레 노토스의 손에 있는 파란색 정령석으로 향한다.): (Baral's gaze slides naturally to the blue spirit stone in Notos's hand.)
Oh. There's what I'm looking for.
strings.(바랄의 말과 함께 그의 등 뒤로 리자드맨 수십 마리가 나타난다. 그러자: (At Baral's words, dozens of lizardmen appear behind him. The air around the swamp entrance changes.)
strings.(무기를 쥔 손에 힘을 주려고 하는 순간, %s의 앞으로 작고 귀여운 파: (As %s tightens their grip on their weapon, a small, adorable bluebird flies over and meets %s's eyes.)
strings.(그 순간, 파랑새를 따라온 것 같은 다른 새들의 울음소리가 협곡을 가득: (The cries of other birds, seemingly following the bluebird, begin to fill the canyon.)
strings.찌르. 찌르르! 찌르르르!! 얘들아, 마족들 확, 찌르!: Chirp. Chirp-chirp! CHIRP! Get those demons, everyone! Chirp!
strings.으아, 시끄러워. 이 새들은 대체 뭐야?: Aagh, that noise! What are these birds?
strings.(바랄이 손을 뻗어 어디선가 날아오는 새들을 밀어낸다. 하지만, 밀어내면: (Baral thrusts out his hands to drive the birds away. But the more he pushes them back, the more fiercely they swarm him and the lizardmen.)
strings.멍청이들아!! 가만히 서있지 말고, 이 새들 다 잡아 없애!!: You idiots! Don't just stand there! Kill every last bird!
strings.(바랄의 성난 목소리에 리자드맨이 무기를 휘두르며 새를 쫓아낸다. 바랄이: (At Baral's furious order, the lizardmen swing their weapons to drive the birds off. Baral shoves past them, but his quarry is already gone.)
I thought this would be easy. They've run off.
strings.어쩔 수 없지. 어차피 다시 만나겠지만, 그 전에 좀 손을 쓸까? 어이,: Well, we'll meet again. But perhaps I should make a few arrangements first. You demons! Lizardmen!
strings.(바랄의 손짓에 새들을 쫓던 리자드맨이 집중한다.): (At Baral's gesture, the lizardmen stop chasing birds and turn their attention to him.)
strings.멍청한 도마뱀들아, 가서 너희 두목에게 전해. 협곡이고 이 버섯밭이고 원: You stupid lizards. Tell your leader to tear this canyon and its mushroom patch apart to his heart's content.
strings.(앞서 날아가던 파랑새가 움직임을 멈추고, 뒤를 따라 바랄에게서 도망가던: (The bluebird stops ahead, and the group fleeing Baral comes to a halt behind it.)
The demons shouldn't be able to follow us this far.
strings.협곡 깊은 곳까지 들어와 버렸네…. 이 새 덕분에 한숨 돌릴 수 있게 됐: We've come deep into the canyon... Thanks to this bird, we can catch our breath.
strings.기분 탓인지는 몰라도 이 새, 분명 다른 새들에게 마족들을 공격하라고 말: Maybe I imagined it, but I could have sworn this bird told the others to attack the demons.
strings.상황이 너무 급박해서 잘못 들으신 거 아닙니까?: Perhaps you misheard in all the confusion?
strings.새가 말할 리가 없잖아. 아니, 정령이면 모르겠지만. 아, 그건 부엉이: Birds can't talk. Unless it's a spirit, of course. Though that was an owl clock spirit. A little different.
strings.부엉이 시계는 또 뭐야? 아, 맞아. 아버지에게 들은 이야기 중에 이런: An owl clock? What are you talking about? Oh, I remember something Father told us. He said he had a spirit for a friend.
I think he said it looked like this bird.
strings.(파랑새가 흠칫 놀라지만, 금방 아무렇지도 않은 척한다.): (The bluebird flinches, then quickly acts as though nothing happened.)
strings.(이 새, 두 사람 말에 반응하네…. 진짜 정령인 것 같은데….): (It keeps reacting to what they're saying... It really must be a spirit...)
I thought Father had made that story up...
strings.정령에게서 정령석을 받았다는 거잖아. 이게 정말 사실일까?: He said a spirit gave him a spirit stone. Could that really be true?
Then I'll ask the owl clock spirit. It'll answer if I ask—
strings.(제피로스와 눈이 마주친 파랑새가 보이지도 않는 작은 날개로 힘차게 날갯: (Meeting Zephyros's eyes, the bluebird beats its tiny, barely visible wings furiously. But a moment later, it drops to the ground.)
strings.(노토스가 떨어진 파랑새를 살펴보려고 하는 순간, 정신을 차린 파랑새가: (As Notos moves to examine the fallen bluebird, it opens its eyes wide and takes flight.)
strings.(파랑새가 도망치듯 파닥거리며 협곡 안으로 날아가 버린다.): (The bluebird flutters deeper into the canyon as though fleeing.)
It flew away when you tried to touch it.
It's slow enough. We should be able to catch up.
strings.어라, 정령이었어요?: Oh? So it was a spirit?
Obviously. It keeps flinching while pretending it isn't.
strings.저 새에게서 흐르는 바람의 기운이 이 정령석의 기운과 일치합니다. 이 기: The wind energy coming from that bird matches this spirit stone. The stone's energy is being drawn toward it.
strings.(제피로스와 노토스가 당연한 걸 왜 물어보냐는 그런 표정을 짓는다.): (Zephyros and Notos look as though the answer should have been obvious.)
Let's follow it and talk, then.
Chirp. They won't make it this far. I've helped enough. Time for a rest.
strings.(파랑새가 서둘러 협곡 안의 비밀 장소로 들어와 적당히 자리를 잡고 앉는: (The bluebird hurries into a secret place in the canyon and finds a comfortable perch. It ruffles its feathers and gently closes its eyes.)
strings.찌르르. 내 정령석이 왜 저기 있는 거지? 설마, 아버지라는 게…. 그리: Chirp-chirp. Why do they have my spirit stone? Could their father be...? And how does a human know Chronos?
strings.찌르. 아, 정령이 인간하고 알 수도 있잖아. 하아…. 자야 해. 그런데: Chirp. Oh, spirits can know humans. Nothing strange about that. Haah... I need sleep. But I'm curious. I'll never fall asleep like this.
strings.(파랑새가 소리를 지르며 날갯짓을 하던 중, 다가오는 %s 일행과 눈이: (As the bluebird cries out and flaps its wings, it meets the eyes of the approaching %s and company.)
You're bigger than that boulder. Stop pretending you're an ordinary little bird.
Chirp-chirp. Oops. I have to get bigger when I rest.
strings.(파랑새가 그제야 상황을 파악했는지 서둘러 뒤로 물러난다. 하지만, 뒤에: (Realizing its mistake, the bluebird hastily backs away. But someone catches it from behind.)
So soft. I could curl up against you and fall asleep.
Chirp. How did humans get in here? And you...
strings.(커다란 파랑새 정령이 %s의 인사를 받다 말고 하늘을 향해 고개를 든다: (The enormous bluebird spirit begins to answer %s, then lifts its head toward the sky.)
strings.찌르르. 어? 널 보니까 왜 여신님 목소리가 들리는 거지?: Chirp-chirp. Huh? Why do I hear the goddess's voice when I look at you?
Chirp-chirp. Yes, I understand, Goddess. This human is yours. You'll visit later? No, you needn't come to such a humble place...
How extraordinary. A spirit speaking with the goddess like this...
strings.찌르르. 여신님과 이야기가 끝났다. 네가 여신님의 축복을 받은 존재라 여: Chirp-chirp. I've finished speaking with the goddess. So you could enter because you bear her blessing.
strings.찌르. 나는 프레이오스 서부를 지키는 바람의 정령왕 실피드. 만나서 반갑: Chirp. I am Sylphid, Wind Spirit King and guardian of western Freios. A pleasure to meet you, %s.
strings.(거대한 파랑새 정령이 자신을 실피드라고 소개하자, 노토스와 제피로스,: (After the giant bluebird introduces himself as Sylphid, Notos, Zephyros, and %s briefly introduce themselves in turn.)
Chirp-chirp. You look as though you have a lot to say to me.
strings.실피드 정령왕님, 저희 아버지 네모를 알고 계십니까? 아버지께서 당신의: Spirit King Sylphid, did you know our father, Nemo? He had your spirit stone.
strings.찌르…. 맞다, 네모. 내가 유일하게 인정한 인간이었지. 우정의 증표로: Chirp... Yes, Nemo. The only human who ever earned my full trust. I gave him that stone as a token of friendship. I told him to bring it to me if he ever needed help...
strings.찌르, 그러고 보니 두 사람 네모를 닮았구나. 에레니스도 닮았고. 눈동자: Chirp. Now that I look, you both resemble Nemo. And Erenis. I can see it in your eyes.
strings.찌르르. 네모는 잘 있고? 에레니스가 세상을 떠나고 못 본 지 좀 된 거: Chirp-chirp. Is Nemo well? I haven't seen him since Erenis passed away. He said he was going to the capital...
Oh... You didn't know. Our father died in an accident ten years ago.
strings.찌르르?! 진짜? 자, 잠깐. 네모가 세상을 떠나다니 그러면 내가 모를: Chirp?! Really? W-wait. If Nemo had died, surely I would have known... Unless it happened in the capital... ?
Yes. At the Magic Bureau in Glaston. He was examining something when there was an accident...
strings.(실피드가 믿어지지 않는지 허공을 오랫동안 바라본다. 그러던 중, 실피드: (Sylphid stares into space for a long time, unable to believe it. A large drop rolls down his feathers and lands on %s's head.)
strings.(실피드가 부르르 몸을 털어 눈에 맺힌 액체도 같이 털어낸다.): (Sylphid shakes himself, scattering the tears in his eyes.)
strings.찌르. 대륙에 바람이 닿지 않는 곳은 없어. 정령들을 거치면 웬만하면 무: Chirp. There's nowhere on the continent the wind doesn't reach. Through the spirits, I can learn almost anything that happens...
strings.찌르르. 그런데 글래스턴에서 일어나는 일만은 느낄 수가 없어. 그렇다고: Chirp-chirp. But I can't sense what happens in Glaston. And I can't simply go there myself.
strings.글래스턴에도 정령이 있을 텐데요?: There must be spirits in Glaston, too.
Chirp. There must be. I don't know why I can't reach them. Phew...
Sylphid, Father is buried in Glaston's memorial park.
Chirp-chirp. Thank you, Nemo's children. Now that I know where he is, I'll visit him.
strings.(네모라는 분, 정령왕이 신뢰할 만큼 좋은 사람이었나 보네….): (Nemo must have been a good man, to earn the Spirit King's trust...)
strings.고맙다. 실피드. 그런데 아버지와는 어떻게 알게 된 거지?: Thank you, Sylphid. How did you meet Father?
strings.찌르. 쉬려고 돌아오는 길에 몸이 약해져 정신을 잃었는데, 마족의 덫에: Chirp. I weakened and lost consciousness on my way back to rest, and got caught in a demon's trap. I nearly ceased to exist. Somehow, Nemo found me and saved me.
strings.찌르르. 나도 모르게 고맙다고 말해버려서 정령인 걸 들켰어. 그게 인연이: Chirp-chirp. I thanked him before I could stop myself, and gave away that I was a spirit. We became friends, and I met Erenis, too.
strings.찌르. 친해지면서 좋은 선물을 주려고 했는데, 한사코 거절하더라. 그래서: Chirp. Once we were close, I wanted to give him a fine gift, but he kept refusing. I told him a spirit would vanish if it failed to bless its rescuer. Only then did he accept.
I've never heard of a spirit vanishing for that reason.
strings.찌르르. 반은 맞고 반은 틀리지만. 어쨌든 네모와 에레니스에겐 정령석을,: Chirp-chirp. It was half true, half not. Anyway, I gave Nemo and Erenis a spirit stone, and you two my blessing of wind.
Chirp. Nemo said that if I was going to bless anyone, it should be his children.
I see. That explains why the breeze always felt so comforting. Thank you, Spirit King.
Wind magic felt right to me from the beginning. Thank you from me, too.
strings.(노토스와 제피로스가 고맙다고 인사하자 실피드가 만족했는지 찡긋 눈인사한: (As Notos and Zephyros thank him, Sylphid gives them a pleased wink.)
Chirp. Good lads. Just what I'd expect of Nemo's children.
strings.찌르. 조금 전에 너희들을 구해주기도 했지만, 마족들을 쫓아내느라 힘을: Chirp. I helped you just now, but I'd already used up my strength driving demons away. I was on my way back.
So you flew here to recover.
strings.찌르. 지금 내가 힘을 회복하려면 최대한 움직이지 않아야 해. 그래서 몸: Chirp. To regain my strength, I have to move as little as possible. That's why I made myself bigger.
Chirp-chirp. The bigger you are, the less you feel like moving. Makes it easier to rest.
That makes a certain amount of sense, but it's a little odd...
strings.찌르. 그런가? 어떻게 하든 간에 빨리 회복해야 협곡도 지키지. 덫에 걸: Chirp. Is it? Whatever works. I need to recover quickly to protect the canyon. Ever since that trap, I haven't been able to leave it. Strange.
strings.바람의 정령왕이시면 소용돌이에 대해서도 아십니까?: As the Wind Spirit King, do you know anything about the vortex?
strings.찌르르. 후우, 저 소용돌이. 말하자면 긴데, 짧게 설명할게. 저건 말이: Chirp-chirp. Ah, that vortex. It's a long story, but I'll keep it short. It didn't form naturally.
strings.찌르. 10년 전이었던가? 20년 전이었던가? 어느 날, 갑자기 협곡 한: Chirp. Ten years ago? Twenty? One day, a huge wind suddenly erupted in the middle of the canyon. It became that vortex and stayed.
strings.찌르르. 일반적인 바람이라면 내가 잠재울 수 있지만, 저건 단순히 그런: Chirp-chirp. I could calm an ordinary wind. But that isn't merely wind.
strings.찌르. 프레이오스 주위에 있던 마력의 흐름이 터져서 바유나 협곡에서 분출: Chirp. The currents of magic around Freios burst open and erupted in Vayuna Canyon.
strings.찌르르. 처음엔 어떻게든 잠재우려고 해봤어. 내 힘을 전부 사용해도 진짜: Chirp-chirp. At first, I tried everything to calm it. But even using all my strength only made it a tiny bit smaller.
strings.찌르. 좀 지나면 다시 원래대로 돌아와. 힘을 다 쓴 난 다시 쉴 수밖에: Chirp. Before long, it returned to normal. And with my strength spent, all I could do was rest again.
strings.찌르르. 일단 내버려두고 있어. 당장 큰일이 일어나는 것도 아니고, 계속: Chirp-chirp. I've left it alone for now. It isn't causing an immediate disaster, and I can't keep draining myself...
Chirp. The demons always come whenever my strength runs out. Phew.
strings.찌르르. 아무튼 할 일이 많아. 쉬고 있다고 아무것도 하지 않는 건 아냐: Chirp-chirp. Anyway, I have plenty to do. Resting doesn't mean I'm doing nothing.
strings.찌르. 마족들이 항상 이곳에 와서 뭔가 찾고 있긴 한데, 그게 뭔지 모르: Chirp. Demons keep coming here to look for something, but I don't know what.
strings.찌르르. 바유나 협곡에서 가져갈 수 있는 거라고 해봐야 버섯밖에 없는데: Chirp-chirp. There's nothing worth taking from Vayuna Canyon except mushrooms.
strings.제피로스, 그 남자가 우리를 보고 했던 말 생각나?: Zephyros, remember what that man said when he saw us?
What was it? Give me a moment...
strings.(노토스와 제피로스가 서로 약속이라도 한 것처럼 기억을 더듬어 바랄이 했: (As though on cue, Notos and Zephyros search their memories for Baral's words.)
I didn't think we'd meet so soon. There's what I'm looking for.
strings.…분명 이렇게 말했다. 그게 대체 뭐…. 아,: ...That's what he said. What could he have meant... Oh.
strings.설마 실피드 님의 정령석을 노리는 건가요?: Could he be after Sylphid's spirit stone?
strings.찌르. 그 정령석은 내가 인정한 사람에게만 주는 증표, 그 이상도 그 이: Chirp. That stone is a token I give only to people I've accepted. Nothing more, nothing less.
strings.(커다란 새와 사람 셋이 머리를 맞대고 바랄의 목적을 짐작하고 있을 때,: (As the giant bird and the three humans put their heads together over Baral's purpose, a flock of birds rises into the quiet canyon sky.)
strings.찌르르. 실핀이 웬만하면 도와달라고 하지 않는데…. 괴로워하고 있어. 가: Chirp-chirp. Sylphins almost never ask for help... They're suffering. I have to go...
strings.(실피드가 서둘러 움직이려고 하다 균형을 잃고 그대로 앞으로 굴러간다.): (Sylphid tries to hurry off, loses his balance, and rolls forward.)
strings.(굴러가던 실피드가 앞에 있던 바위에 몸을 부딪치고 나서야 멈춘다.): (He only stops when he rolls into a boulder.)
strings.실피드 님, 괜찮아요? 어?: Sylphid, are you all right? Huh?
Chiiirp... I'm still a long way from recovering, but I'll do my best...
Sylphid, I think you'd better rest.
strings.(제피로스가 두손으로 쓰러진 실피드의 상태를 살펴본다.): (Zephyros examines the fallen Sylphid, cradling him in both hands.)
strings.찌르. 너희들, 갑자기 커진 거 같다?: Chirp. Have you all suddenly gotten bigger?
Chirp. It must be because I blasted those demons away before I'd recovered. What do I do now...?
strings.노토스 님하고 제피로스. 실피드 님하고 잠깐 같이 계시겠어요? 제가 가서: Notos, Zephyros. Could you stay with Sylphid a moment? I'll go and look.
strings.%s, 나도 가겠다. 둘이 여기 있긴 너무 많은 거 같고, 내가 가도 될: I'm coming, too, %s. He doesn't need both of us here. Notos, take the Spirit King.
Birds have always liked Notos better than me, anyway.
strings.그건 그렇긴 하지만, 내가 같이 안 가도 되겠어?: That's true, but are you sure you don't need me with you?
If the Spirit King is in danger, the winds across the western continent will be affected. Someone has to stay and protect him.
strings.실피드 정령왕님, 여기서 저와 함께 계시죠. 저 녀석보단 제가 조금 더: Stay here with me, Spirit King Sylphid. I'm a little more dependable than he is. I'm the older brother, after all.
You'll insist on that to your dying breath, won't you...?
strings.찌르. 그러면 나도 회복에 전념하지. 아, 줬다가 뺏는 건 아니고, 내: Chirp. Then I'll focus on recovering. Oh, I'm not taking back my gift, but could you put my spirit stone over there for a moment?
strings.(노토스가 정령석을 실피드가 가리킨 곳에 살며시 놓아둔다. 그러자 실피드: (Notos gently places the stone where Sylphid indicates. With a few small wingbeats, Sylphid settles on top of it.)
strings.찌르르. 이 위에서 잠시 눈 감고 있을게. 노토스, 혹시 마족이 온다면: Chirp-chirp. I'll close my eyes here for a while. Notos, if demons come, think of the wind blowing from the south.
strings.(그말과 함께 실피드가 파란 정령석 위에서 눈을 감는다.): (With that, Sylphid closes his eyes atop the blue spirit stone.)
Notos, wait here with the Spirit King. We'll be back.
All right, %s. Take care of Zephyros for me.
(Zephyros examines the fallen mushroom monster at his feet and sighs.)
These monsters almost never leave the swamp.
strings.이 몬스터는 사람들을 만나면 쫓아오다가도 밖이 보이면 다시 늪지로 돌아가: Even when they're chasing people, they turn back the moment the edge of the swamp comes into view.
strings.마족에게 공격받아도 집 밖을 싫어해서 절대 나오지 않는다는 이야기도 종종: People say they hate leaving home so much, they won't come out even when demons attack...
I don't know what power Baral has, but I doubt it's enough to cause this.
strings.(제피로스가 가리킨 몬스터의 팔에 작은 그을음이 남겨져 있다.): (Zephyros points to a small scorch mark on the monster's arm.)
strings.어떤 마족이 외부의 존재를 세뇌시킬 때 특정 범위에 검은 안개를 뿌린다는: I've heard some demons spread black mist over an area to enslave the minds of creatures from other realms. This may be something similar.
strings.분명 일반적인 마족은 아닐 테고…. %s, 왜 그래?: It certainly wouldn't be an ordinary demon... What's wrong, %s?
Baral is standing by that huge mushroom in the distance.
Has he come to greet us alone? Wait, %s.
strings.혼자 나온 걸 보니 뭔가 할 이야기가 있는 것 같군요. 가서 들어봐야겠어: If he's alone, he must have something to say. I'll hear him out. Though I doubt he'll tell us everything.
I understand. We'd better be fully prepared.
Yes. Once we're ready, let's enter the swamp.
strings.(불과 몇 걸음 걸어갔을 뿐인데, 협곡과는 다른 분위기의 새로운 장소가: (After only a few steps, a new landscape opens up, with an atmosphere entirely unlike the canyon's.)
strings.(습하다 못해 끈적끈적한 느낌이 온몸을 감싸는 가운데, 앞에서 기다리고: (The air is so damp it clings to the skin. The unwelcome figure waiting ahead approaches with an ill-fitting smile.)
strings.애송이, 조금 전까지는 도망가더니, 이제야 기어 나오는군. 그건 어디다: Whelp. You ran away a moment ago, and now you finally crawl out. Where did you hide it?
Whatever you want, you won't get your way.
strings.어차피 알고 있으면서 내 입에서 그게 뭔지 듣고 싶은 모양인 것 같네?: You already know, but you want to hear me say it, is that it?
Hand over the spirit stone you were carrying, and I'll spare your lives.
So you recognized it wasn't an ordinary stone.
What do you want it for...?
strings.알고 싶다면 날 쓰러뜨려라. 양카스가 버섯나무 늪지와 협곡을 전부 엉망으: If you want to know, defeat me. Before Yankas destroys the swamp and the canyon alike.
strings.양카스는 마계 군단장 후보 중 하나다. 잔혹하기로는 바이스 못지않고, 이: One of the candidates for legion commander in the Demon Realm. As cruel as Weiss. Lux lent him to me specially, at a witch's request.
strings.다른 놈을 배신하고 럭스에게 붙었다는데, 과연. 한 번 배신한 놈이 또: They say he betrayed someone else to join Lux. Though if he betrayed one master, what's to stop him betraying another... ?
strings.스승을 배신하고 나쁜 짓을 하고 다니는 게 완전히 바랄 당신 이야기인데?: Betraying a teacher and going around doing evil? You're describing yourself, Baral. Weiss, a witch, and now Lux, lord of the Demon Realm...
strings.내가 뭘 하든지 너희들과는 상관없지 않나?: Whatever I do is none of your concern.
strings.(바랄의 말과 함께 그의 팔에 감겨 있던 쇠사슬이 풀리면서 %s에게 날아: (The chains around Baral's arm uncoil and lash toward %s. He then meets %s's attack with apparent ease.)
You won't get away with this, Baral.
strings.(바랄이 말과는 달리 인상을 잔뜩 구긴다. 다시 여러 번, 공격해보지만,: (Despite his words, Baral grimaces. He attacks again and again, but seems overwhelmed by %s's newfound force.)
strings.(저 바랄이라는 남자도 일반적인 인간을 벗어나 있지만, %s의 움직임은…: (That man Baral is beyond an ordinary human, too. But the way %s moves... Even more inhuman than when we fought...)
strings.(바랄이 %s의 공격을 맞고 그대로 바위에 부딪혀 쓰러진다. 자세를 잡고: (Struck by %s, Baral crashes into a rock and falls. He regains his stance and prepares to attack, then freezes at the tip of %s's weapon before his eyes.)
Now talk. What do you want here?
strings.후, 어쩔 수 없지. 난 의뢰를 받고 여기 온 것뿐. 날 고용한 마녀가: Hmph. Very well. I'm only here on a commission. The witch who hired me wants...
strings.바유나 협곡에 있는 정령왕의 소멸이다. 그리고 정령석이 바유나 협곡 근처: The Spirit King of Vayuna Canyon destroyed. She said his spirit stone was somewhere near the canyon and told me to find it.
strings.마녀가 왜 정령의 소멸을 바라는지 모르겠군. 널 고용할 정도의 마녀라면: Why would a witch want to destroy a spirit? A witch powerful enough to hire you shouldn't need a spirit's power.
Tell me who hired you, Baral. And what you're getting in return.
strings.마계에 갔을 때, 럭스에게 부탁받은 것 뿐. 어떤 마녀인지는 모른다. 그: Lux passed on the request when I visited the Demon Realm. I don't know which witch it was. As for my payment...
strings.내가 이런 것까지 이야기할 필요가 있나?: Do I really need to tell you that much?
Take the demons you brought and leave, and we'll spare your life.
Well, that's awkward. I'm rather hard to kill.
strings.(바랄의 말에 제피로스가 주위를 돌아본 순간, 몸을 숨기고 있던 리자드맨: (At Baral's words, Zephyros looks around. Dozens of hidden lizardmen reveal themselves.)
I knew you were hiding something... But this is hardly enough.
strings.(제피로스가 마법서를 펼치자 다가오려는 리자드맨의 발밑에서 커다란 바람이: (Zephyros opens his spellbook. A powerful wind rises beneath the approaching lizardmen, whirling into a vortex that sends some of them flying.)
strings.(그 틈을 타 바랄이 제피로스의 마법을 무시하듯 소용돌이 사이로 들어간다: (Seizing the opening, Baral steps into the vortex as though Zephyros's magic means nothing.)
strings.(바랄이 뒤를 돌아보자마자 팔에 감겨 있던 쇠사슬을 휘두른다. 다시 한: (Baral turns and lashes out with the chains around his arm. Zephyros casts again and %s attacks, but Baral deflects both.)
strings.적당히 어울려 준 것치고 나쁘지 않군. 자, 이제 네 놈들은 양카스를 상: Not bad, considering I was only humoring you. Now you'll have to face Yankas.
strings.상대를 죽인 후에 피를 마시는 아주 잔혹한 리자드맨이지. 그런 양카스 녀: A wonderfully vicious lizardman who drinks his victims' blood. He's inside Mushroom Tree Swamp right now.
strings.아마도 녀석은 지시받은 대로 열심히 늪지, 더 나아가 바유나 협곡도 모두: He'll be hard at work following orders. Destroying the swamp, and then all of Vayuna Canyon.
strings.그때쯤 되면 정령왕도 모습을 드러내겠지…. 정령이란 건 생명이 있는 땅을: By then, the Spirit King will show himself. Spirits cherish lands that nurture life, after all.
strings.(혼신의 힘을 담은 %s의 공격이 이어지지만, 바랄은 아무렇지도 않은 듯: (%s strikes with all their strength, but Baral parries with apparent ease.)
strings.자, 선택해라. 양카스가 버섯나무 늪지를 비롯해 협곡을 파괴하는 걸 막을: Choose. Will you stop Yankas from destroying the swamp and canyon? Or chase me as I hunt the Spirit King?
Either way, the Spirit King will appear before me. With every last bit of his power spent.
strings.(그 말과 함께 또 어디서 나타났는지 모를 리자드맨 수십, 수백 마리가: (Dozens, then hundreds of lizardmen pour out of nowhere and charge at %s and Zephyros.)
strings.%s하고 마법사, 할 수만 있다면 여기서도 버텨봐, 그리고 양카스에게도: %s. Mage. Survive this if you can. Then see if you can make it past Yankas alive.
strings.(두 사람이 리자드맨 무리를 상대하는 동안, 바랄의 모습이 버섯나무 늪지: (As the pair fight the lizardmen, Baral retreats farther and farther from Mushroom Tree Swamp.)
strings.먼저 이놈들을 처리해야 해!: We have to deal with these first!
strings.(제피로스가 만들어낸 날카로운 바람이 리자드맨의 품으로 날아간다. 그걸: (Zephyros sends blades of wind into the lizardmen. As they dodge, %s strikes.)
strings.(그렇게 한 마리 남은 리자드맨마저 쓰러지자 제피로스가 확인할 겸 상태를: (When the final lizardman falls, Zephyros checks that it is down for good.)
strings.%s, 가서 바랄을 쫓아. 내가 걸었던 주문이 아직 유효할 테니까 이 도: Go after Baral, %s. The spell I put on him should still hold. Take this device, and...
You go after Baral, Zephyros. I'll deal with Yankas.
strings.그게 무슨 소리야? 지금 늪지에 있는 몬스터하고 마족들을 전부 상대하게?: What are you saying? You'll fight every monster and demon in this swamp?
strings.하아, 이미 결심했네. 알았다. 내가 바랄을 따라가지. 그리고 시간을 벌: Haah. You've already made up your mind. All right. I'll follow Baral and keep him from reaching Sylphid. Buy you some time. Meanwhile...
Don't worry too much. I have Iris behind me.
No one could ask for better support. Hurry, then.
strings.(제피로스가 가볍게 웃으며 늪지 밖을 향해 달려 나간다.): (Zephyros gives a small smile and runs toward the swamp's edge.)
strings.분명 양카스가 군단장 후보라고 했지. 그러면 전에 상대했던 군단장보다는…: He said Yankas was a candidate for legion commander. So compared with the commanders I've already fought...
Enough pointless thoughts. Keep moving. No opponent will be easy.
strings.(늪지를 가로지르는 동안, %s에게 마계에서 건너온 리자드맨을 비롯해 늪: (As %s crosses the swamp, lizardmen from the Demon Realm and the swamp's own monsters attack.)
Haah... Haah... There's no end to them.
strings.(마지막으로 덤벼드는 몬스터를 처리하고 숨을 고르고 있던 %s의 앞으로: (After defeating the last attacker, %s pauses for breath. A vast shadow falls over them.)
You wish to see the end, my esteemed opponent? In that case...
strings.(커다란 그림자의 주인이 팔을 드는 순간, 강한 힘이 몰려와 파란 빛으로: (The shadow's owner raises an arm. Power gathers in a blue radiance, lifting him skyward before he crashes down.)
strings.(무게를 실은 엄청난 공격에 굉음과 함께 지면에서 커다란 폭발이 일어난다: (The crushing blow strikes with a deafening roar, blasting the ground apart.)
A fine dodge, my esteemed opponent.
strings.(늪지에 피어오른 물안개 같은 것이 조금씩 사라지면서 자세를 다잡고 있는: (As the swamp mist slowly clears, %s regains their footing and sees a huge, powerful figure.)
So composed in the presence of an enemy commander. I must commend your bearing.
strings.(사람의 서너 배 정도 되는 커다란 크기의 리자드맨이 날카롭고 단단해보이: (A lizardman three or four times a human's size wears sharp, sturdy plate armor and gauntlets almost as large as his body.)
strings.바랄에게서 내 이야기를 들었소? 그렇다면 소장이 누군지 어느 정도 알고: Has Baral spoken of me? Then you must have some idea who I am.
The general who will fill the legion commander's seat your exploits left vacant.
strings.선생이 소장에게 원하는 게 무엇이오? 어차피 뻔한 대답이겠지만, 들어보겠: What do you wish of me? I expect the answer is obvious, but I shall hear it.
strings.(말은 점잖은 척하지만, 상대를 깔보는 것 같은 말투네. 말투는 다르지만: (He acts polite, but every word drips with contempt. It reminds me of someone, though they speak differently. Who was it...? It's irritating.)
strings.어서 말해보시오. 혹시 시간을 벌고 있는 것이오?: Speak. Or are you perhaps stalling for time?
Yankas, take your troops and leave the canyon. Now.
strings.선생, 잘 들으시오. 선생의 말씀이 소장의 일과 어울리는 거라면 기꺼이: Listen carefully. If your request aligned with my duty, I would gladly withdraw. However...
strings.(양카스가 팔을 들더니 건틀릿에 묻은 붉은 얼룩을 혀로 핥는다.): (Yankas raises an arm and licks a red stain from his gauntlet.)
It does not. I must therefore carry out my liege's commands.
strings.그래서 럭스가 시킨 일이 뭐야?: And what did Lux order you to do?
strings.선생, 주군의 존함을 함부로 입에 담지 마시오. 하아, 그러고 보니 내가: Do not speak my liege's name so lightly. Ah... I believe I've allowed you to live quite long enough.
strings.(순간, 양카스의 눈매가 날카로워지면서 거대한 건틀릿이 다시 땅으로 떨어: (Yankas's eyes narrow, and his enormous gauntlet slams down again.)
There are your true colors, demon Yankas.
strings.(양카스가 건틀릿을 들고 공격을 피한 모험가를 바라본다. 그리고는 혀를: (Yankas lifts his gauntlet and watches the adventurer who evaded him. His tongue flicks out as he smacks his lips.)
strings.오랜만에 제대로 된 인간의 피를 마셔야겠소. 지금까지는 맛없는 피만 마셨: At last, some proper human blood. Everything I've tasted lately has been so insipid...
strings.확실히 신의 가호를 받은 인간이라면 피 맛이 달라도 좀 다르지 않겠소?: Surely a human blessed by a god will taste rather different?
strings.자, 선생. 군단장이 될 나를 위해 기꺼이 제물이 되어주시오!!: Now, my esteemed opponent. Offer yourself willingly to your future legion commander!
strings.(양카스가 %s의 일격을 받고, 그대로 뒤로 밀려난다. 다시 자세를 고쳐: (%s's blow drives Yankas backward. He tries to regain his stance, but sinks to the ground.)
strings.(커다란 버섯을 지팡이 삼아 일어서려 하지만, 미끄러져 제대로 붙잡지도: (He reaches for a giant mushroom to haul himself up, but his hand slips.)
strings.양카스, 네게 승산이 없다는 걸 알겠지?: You understand you can't win, Yankas?
Tell me what Lux ordered you to do.
strings.(피를 토하던 양카스가 %s의 얼굴을 빤히 바라보다가 실없이 웃기 시작한: (Coughing blood, Yankas stares at %s, then begins to laugh.)
strings.선생은 역시 인간이다 싶어서…. 마족들은 여차하면 목부터 자르거나 심장을: You really are human... A demon would have taken my head or pierced my heart by now. Heh. Cough, cough.
Still flapping your tongue, even now.
I'm a lizardman. Using my tongue comes naturally. Cough, cough.
...I never thought I'd fall to a human like this.
strings.(양카스가 쓰러진 채로 말없이 하늘을 바라본다.): (Yankas lies still, staring silently at the sky.)
strings.선생에게 쓰러져 어차피 죽을 목숨. 선생이 해결할 수 있을지는 모르겠지만: You've defeated me. I'm dead anyway. I don't know if you can do anything about it, but I'll tell you.
My liege won't spare a thought for me, I'm sure. Hahaha...
strings.선생, 이제 곧 문이 하나 생길 것이오. 그 문이 어떤 역할을 할지는 선: A gate will soon appear. I believe you already know what purpose it will serve.
A gate to the Demon Realm...
strings.그중 어떤 문이 될지는 모르겠소. 크큭…. 쿨럭, 쿨럭. 겨우 시간을 버: Which kind of gate, I cannot say. Heh... Cough, cough. To dream of becoming a legion commander, when all I was meant to do was buy time...
If this is how it ends, perhaps betraying the Grand Duke was a mistake. Cough, cough.
The Grand Duke? So that's whose service you betrayed...
strings.다른 마족이라면 배신과 함께 소장을 죽이려 했겠지만, 그는 달랐소. 크큭: Any other demon would have tried to kill me for my betrayal. But he was different. Heh.
strings.(양카스가 말을 이어가려고 하는 순간, 협곡 어딘가에 커다란 뭔가가 떨어: (Before Yankas can finish, something enormous lands somewhere in the canyon. Yankas lets out a sharp cry.)
strings.(언제 꺼냈는지 모를 날카로운 비수가 모험가의 반격으로 양카스의 목에 깊: (A dagger, drawn so stealthily it went unnoticed, is buried deep in Yankas's neck by the adventurer's counterattack.)
If I hadn't heard your sneer beneath that sound from the canyon, I might have died...
strings.(잠시 후, 양카스의 몸이 검게 그을리더니 순식간에 검은 재가 된다. 그: (A moment later, Yankas's body blackens and crumbles into ash. The breeze carries it away through Mushroom Tree Swamp.)
strings.무슨 저주 같은 거라도 걸은 건가?: Was he under some kind of curse?
strings.후우, 복잡하게 생각하지 말고 빨리 가자. 분명 문이라고 했으니까, 또: Phew. No time to overthink it. He said a gate. It must be another gate to the Demon Realm...
strings.(제피로스가 양카스의 전투를 끝내고 숨을 돌리고 있는 %s에게로 서둘러: (Zephyros hurries toward %s, who is catching their breath after the battle with Yankas.)
strings.협곡 아래로 내려가는 길은 저쪽 큰길 하나밖에 없고 막다른 곳인데…, 증: There's only one main road down the canyon, and the other end is a dead end... But he vanished into thin air.
strings.실피드의 존재를 알고 여기까지 온 걸 보면 분명 정보가 없는 건 아닐 거: He knew about Sylphid and came all this way. He must have some information.
But there's a bigger problem. That's why I came back.
strings.아직도 늪지 안에 리자드맨들이 있는 것 같으니까, 늪지를 나간 후에 이야: There seem to be lizardmen left in the swamp. Let's get out first, then talk.
Agreed. I learned something from Yankas, too...
strings.문이 나타날 시간을 벌려고 했던 건가?: He was buying time for a gate to appear?
They've tried to connect the Demon Realm to Freios repeatedly. But I have a bad feeling this time is different.
strings.혹시 몰라 실피드가 있는 장소로 돌아가려고 했지만, 갑자기 펼쳐진 장벽: I tried to return to Sylphid, just in case. But a barrier had appeared, and I couldn't get through.
strings.무슨 짓을 해도, 내 힘으로는 도저히 지나가지 못하더군. 하아…. 그래서: Nothing I did worked. My power wasn't enough. Haah... I had no choice but to come find you.
I think we were only able to enter the Spirit King's domain because you were with us.
strings.실피드가 잠시 쉬어가던 장소 알지? 그 근처에 실피드의 환영이 남아있어서: Remember where Sylphid stopped to rest? An image of him was still there nearby. I tried speaking to it, but it didn't answer.
Probably because it wasn't his actual body.
Let's check Sylphid's image first, Zephyros.
strings.(%s의 말에 제피로스가 고개를 끄덕이고 앞장서 뛰어간다.): (At %s's words, Zephyros nods and runs ahead.)
strings.(실피드가 있었던 장소에 작은 실피드의 모습이 아무런 움직임 없이 허공에: (A small image of Sylphid floats motionless where he had been.)
You're right, Zephyros. Sylphid's image isn't moving at all.
strings.보통 환영은 본체의 의지대로 움직일 텐데, 이렇게 움직이지 않는 건 이유: An image like that usually acts at its owner's will. There must be a reason it's motionless.
strings.(어, 그런데 실피드님의 환영이 바라보는 방향에 있는 건 뭐지?): (Wait. What's that in the direction Sylphid's image is facing?)
No, I must have imagined it. Let's hurry, Zephyros.
strings.(제피로스가 %s의 뒤를 따라 실피드가 쉬던 장소로 들어온다. 그리고 큰: (Following %s into Sylphid's resting place, Zephyros calls loudly for the others.)
strings.(두 사람이 주위를 살펴보고 있을 때, 실피드가 실핀이라고 했던 작은 새: (As they look around, the little birds Sylphid called Sylphins gather and settle in one spot.)
strings.(새들의 시끄러운 지저귐에 두 사람이 달려가자 그 사이에서 손을 뻗은 채: (They hurry toward the noisy birds and find Notos collapsed among them, one hand outstretched.)
Where... Oh, right. This is where Sylphid was...
strings.(노토스가 제피로스의 부축을 받고 일어나 주위를 둘러본다.): (With Zephyros's support, Notos stands and looks around.)
I'm all right, but I believe the Spirit King has been abducted.
It happened so quickly. I couldn't do anything.
strings.괜찮아요, 노토스 님. 상황을 알려주세요. 그래야 실피드 님을 구하러 가: It's all right, Notos. Tell us what happened so we can go rescue Sylphid.
strings.고위 마족으로 보이는, 특이하게도 뿔이 부러진 자가 나타나서 정령왕을 데: Someone who appeared to be a high-ranking demon came to take him. Strangely, one of his horns was broken. I tried to stop him, but...
He said it was nothing personal, then shot me with an arrow. I lost consciousness...
He doesn't seem to have intended to kill you. Thankfully, there's not a scratch on you...
Oh... He said Lux wanted him brought to the gate.
strings.바랄을 미끼 삼아 우릴 유인하고, 양카스로 시간을 벌어 실피드를 납치하다: They used Baral to lure us away, and Yankas to buy time while they abducted Sylphid...
I don't think they simply want his power.
strings.실피드 님이 프레이오스 서부의 바람을 담당한다고 그랬으니까 그 바람을 이: Sylphid said he governs the winds of western Freios. Could they be trying to use those winds?
(At %s's words, Notos and Zephyros look at each other in unison.)
strings.단순히 정령왕을 없앤다고 프레이오스가 바로 떨어지는 건 아니야…. 다른: Destroying the Spirit King alone wouldn't make Freios fall. Other spirits would take over his work.
strings.다만, 하급 정령들에게 영향을 주는 정령왕이 직접적으로 명령을 한다면 이: But if the Spirit King himself ordered the lesser spirits under his influence, that would be another matter.
strings.정령왕 실피드 님을 마계로 데리고 간 이유가 세뇌……?: They took Sylphid to the Demon Realm to control his mind...?
We can't know for certain until we see for ourselves.
strings.빨리 문을 찾아야겠군요. 정령석은 제게 있으니 금방 찾을 수 있을 겁니다: We have to find the gate quickly. I still have the spirit stone, so it shouldn't take long.
strings.실피드 님의 환영이 있던 곳 근처 아래에서 뭔가 본 거 같아요. 아무래도: I thought I saw something below, near Sylphid's image. We should check there.
strings.그건 그렇고, 노토스 님. 정말 괜찮으신 거 맞아요?: But Notos, are you sure you're all right?
You needn't worry at all. I'm tougher than I look...
strings.안 본 사이, 쓸데없는 허세만 늘었잖아. 괜찮다니 다행이지만, 너무 무리: You've only gotten more boastful since I last saw you. I'm glad you're all right, but don't push yourself.
Haha, Zephyros. No one looks out for his big brother quite like you.
Haah... Sorry I brought this brother of mine along, %s.
It's all right. I'm glad you get along.
Get along...? Enough of that. Let's find a clue.
strings.(세 사람이 왔던 길로 돌아가 실피드의 환영이 있는 곳에 도착한다. 환영: (The three retrace their steps to Sylphid's image. It still floats motionless in the air.)
strings.실피드 님이 이곳에 자신의 환영을 만들었군요. 아마도 흔적을 남겨 우리들: Sylphid left an image of himself here. Perhaps he wanted to leave a trail for us to follow...
But I can't see anything that could be a gate.
strings.벌써 문이 사라진 건 아니겠지?: It hasn't already disappeared, has it?
There seems to be a path in the direction the image is facing.
The energy from the spirit stone is heading that way, too, %s...
Wait, %s. We'll go together. Ah, already gone.
Where our family used to have picnics...
strings.(제피로스와 노토스가 %s의 뒤를 쫓아 도착한 길 끝에 협곡과는 전혀 어: (Following %s to the end of the path, Zephyros and Notos find a suspicious structure utterly out of place in the canyon.)
That gate couldn't look more suspicious.
strings.(문의 양옆으로 타오르는 횃불에서 위로 시선을 옮기는 순간, 뿔달린 악마: (Looking up from the torches burning on either side, the adventurer meets the gaze of an ornament resembling a horned devil's head.)
strings.데고스 같은 경우엔 예전 자기 저택 같은 걸 이용했는데, 이 문 안 공간: Degos used something like his old mansion. Whoever made this gate isn't trying to hide that the Demon Realm lies beyond it.
There are blue feathers on the ground. Sylphid must be inside. The spirit stone is reacting, too.
strings.(노토스의 손에 있던 실피드의 정령석 주위로 작은 바람이 일어난다.): (A small breeze stirs around Sylphid's spirit stone in Notos's hand.)
And there's a magical barrier here.
strings.(제피로스가 손을 뻗지만, 문은 그를 허락하지 않고 밀어낸다.): (Zephyros reaches out, but the gate refuses him and pushes him back.)
strings.이걸 해체하려면 시간이 조금 걸릴 것 같은데…. 어?: It'll take some time to dismantle this... Huh?
strings.(장벽을 넘어 굳게 닫혀 있던 문이 %s의 손길에 안으로 밀린다. 그리고: (At %s's touch, the tightly shut gate beyond the barrier swings inward, leaving a gap wide enough to enter.)
It's open. I only reached out like you did, Zephyros...
strings.이걸 뭐라고 해야 하지…. 분명 마계의 문인데, 신의 가호를 받은 인물에: What am I supposed to make of that...? A gate to the Demon Realm responding to someone blessed by a god...
Think about it later, Zephyros. Let's go in.
It could be dangerous, so I'll go first. Wait here a moment.
strings.(문틈 사이로 들어가는 순간, 조금 전 협곡과는 전혀 다른 분위기의 세계: (Stepping through the gap reveals a world utterly unlike the canyon.)
strings.(아무것도 없는 어둠 속, 저 멀리 무수한 별빛이 반짝거리고 있다. 그리: (In an empty darkness, countless distant lights glitter like stars. Only %s stands within, gazing at the sight.)
What is this place? Just looking at it feels strange...
strings.(신비하다 못해 쓸쓸함이 느껴지는 장소를 파악하기 위해 조금씩 걷던 중,: (Walking slowly through the mysterious, desolate space, %s begins to make out things that were invisible before.)
strings.(별처럼 빛나는 줄 알았던 것들이 가까워지면서 형태를 갖춘다.): (As the lights draw closer, what seemed to be stars takes shape.)
strings.(눈앞에 보이는 것들은 다양한 크기와 색을 지닌 여러 종류의 문. 그런: (Doors of every size, color, and kind drift through the cosmic space, drawing %s's gaze.)
strings.열린 문도 있고, 닫힌 문도 있고…. 아, 풍경에 감탄하고 있을 때가 아: Some open, some closed... No, this isn't the time to admire the view.
Chirp? %s? I'm here! Get me out of here, quickly!
strings.(실피드를 찾는 %s의 외침에 어디선가 실피드의 목소리가 들려온다.): (At %s's call, Sylphid's voice answers from somewhere.)
strings.(문밖에 없는 공간에서 실피드의 목소리가 들려오지만, 모습이 전혀 보이지: (His voice echoes through the space filled with doors, but he is nowhere to be seen.)
strings.찌르르. 뿔이 부러진 마족이 갑자기 습격하더니 날 이곳으로 납치했어. 커: Chirp-chirp. A demon with a broken horn suddenly attacked and abducted me. He opened a huge door and locked me inside. Aagh, it won't open!
Sylphid, there are rather a lot of doors here.
I can see more than thirty from where I'm standing. Please wait a moment.
strings.찌르! 찌르르!! 이 마족을 만나기만 하면 확, 찌르!!: Chirp! CHIRP! When I get my wings on that demon, I'll—CHIRP!
strings.(실피드가 화가 났는지 계속해서 소리를 지른다. 그런 그때, 눈 앞에 보: (Sylphid keeps shouting in fury. Then one of the many doors opens, and someone slowly steps through.)
strings.(붉은색 뿔을 가진 건장한 체격의 청년이 한 걸음씩 걸어나올 때마다 발에: (A sturdy young man with red horns approaches, the shackles on his feet clattering with every step.)
strings.(마족? 뿔이 부러졌네…. 아, 그 마족인가?): (A demon? His horn is broken... Is this the one?)
A human who entered the Gate of Lysithea of their own accord...
Return Sylphid, and I'll leave quietly.
strings.실피드? 그게 정령왕의 이름인가?: Sylphid? Is that the Spirit King's name?
Chirp? %s, is that demon here? You! How dare you treat a Spirit King—
strings.(마족 청년이 손끝에서 날카로운 화살을 만들어낸다. 그리고 들고 있던 활: (The young demon forms a sharp arrow at his fingertips, nocks it to his bow, and fires into the air.)
strings.(화살이 여러 개로 분리되어 모든 문을 향해 떨어진다. 그리고 문이 잠기: (The arrow splits into many, falling toward every door. Locks click shut one after another.)
strings.(더는 실피드의 목소리가 들려오지 않는다. 게다가 이 공간으로 들어오는: (Sylphid's voice is gone. Every sound from beyond this space seems to have been cut off, leaving only silence.)
All the doors are locked now.
strings.(뿔이 부러진 마족 청년의 말에 서둘러 되돌아가려고 하지만, 알 수 없는: (At the broken-horned demon's words, the adventurer hastens back, but an unseen wall blocks the way.)
strings.이곳은 리시테아의 문. 스스로 찾아왔다면 이 공간에 대해서도 알고 있을: This is the Gate of Lysithea. Since you came of your own accord, I assumed you knew this place. Apparently not.
strings.뒤틀린 자가 자신을 위해 만든 공간이다. 지금은 마계에서 관리하면서 구속: A space the Twisted One created for personal use. Now the Demon Realm controls it. A place to bind and imprison anything that can be bound.
strings.인간이라서 날 모르나 보군. 나는 안드레아. 이곳에서 갇힌 채 살아가는: A human wouldn't know me, I suppose. I am Andrea. This place's keeper, and its prisoner.
strings.(안드레아라고 자신을 소개한 마족 청년이 %s의 얼굴을 응시한다.): (The young demon who introduced himself as Andrea gazes at %s's face.)
strings.갇혔다면서 문에서 나와 정령왕을 데리고 간 건 어떻게 설명할 거지?: If you're a prisoner, how did you leave through the gate and take the Spirit King?
strings.그건 나도 알고 싶은 건데…. 왜 정령왕이 있던 협곡에서 문이 열린 건지: I'd like to know that myself... Why did a door open in the canyon where the Spirit King was? In any case, I only brought him here at Lux's request.
strings.날 럭스의 부하라 본 건가? 마음대로 생각해라. 그리고 정령왕이 분명 널: You think I serve Lux? Believe what you like. The Spirit King called you %s, didn't he? %s?
strings.(그순간 정적이었던 안드레아의 얼굴에 조소가 잔뜩 피어오른다. 그건 마치: (Andrea's impassive face suddenly fills with mocking delight, as though he has found something he has long awaited.)
I knew you weren't an ordinary human, coming here on your own.
strings.(안드레아가 말을 끝내자마자 손끝에서 화살을 만든 후, 활에 건다.): (As soon as he finishes speaking, Andrea forms an arrow at his fingertips and sets it to his bow.)
strings.(안드레아의 화살이 %s의 머리 위로 향하고. 커다란 소리와 함께 허공에: (Andrea's arrow flies over %s's head. With a crash, one of the doors suspended above breaks apart.)
strings.(눈깜짝할 사이에 안드레아가 부서진 문 위로 올라서서 아래를 바라본다.): (In the blink of an eye, Andrea stands atop the shattered door, looking down.)
strings.(안드레아가 등을 돌린 채, 부서진 문 안으로 들어간다. 그리고 의미심장: (Turning away, Andrea steps into the broken doorway, leaving a pointed warning.)
strings.네가 여기서 나갈 수 있을지. 아니면 이유도 모른 채 영원히 갇히게 되겠: Prove you can leave this place. Or remain trapped forever, without ever knowing why.
strings.(%s의 외침을 뒤로 한 채, 안드레아가 부서진 문 안으로 들어간다. 잠: (Ignoring %s's cry, Andrea steps through the broken door. A moment later, the door that swallowed him vanishes into thin air.)
I can't go back, and I can't follow Andrea...
strings.결국 원하는 대로 이 문을 전부 열고 찾아야 한다는 거네. 어쩔 수 없지: So I have to do what he wants. Open all these doors and search. No choice but to try...
strings.열쇠가 없어서 열리지도 않는 문과 네 힘으로 밀어도 밀리지 않는 문이 대: Most should have been locked without a key, or too heavy for your strength to move...
To open even the keeper's door... You're no ordinary visitor. Well done.
strings.(안드레아가 가볍게 손을 흔들자 모험가를 쫓아오던 헬파이어가 물러난다.): (With a casual wave, Andrea dismisses the Hellfire pursuing the adventurer.)
strings.왜 물리는 거지? 여유라도 부리는 거야?: Why call it off? Feeling generous?
strings.여기서 대화? 네가 말한 증명이 뭔지는 모르겠지만, 내가 해냈는지 그것부: A conversation? I don't know what you wanted me to prove, but first tell me if I've done it.
Impatient, aren't you? I could tell you what you need to know, if you wish...
strings.네가 싫다고 해도 선택지는 없다. 문이 닫힌 순간부터 네 손으로 열 수: Refuse if you like, but you have no choice. Once the doors close, you can't open any of them yourself.
Your reaction suggests we can negotiate. Let's say you've proven yourself halfway.
strings.그래, 좋아. 럭스의 부하도 아니라면서, 왜 럭스의 지시를 따르는 거지?: Fine. You say you don't serve Lux. Then why follow his orders?
Well, now. Straight to the point...
strings.어떤 세계나 같겠지만, 마계도 오직 강한 자가 살아남는다. 그래서 최고가: Perhaps it's the same in every world, but in the Demon Realm, only the strong survive. We constantly crush the weak and defeat the strong to prove ourselves and reach the top.
strings.나와 동생은 살아남기 위해 공격해 오는 다른 마족들을 모두 죽였다. 그리: My younger brother and I killed every demon that attacked us to survive. We grew stronger. These red horns are proof enough.
Fighting made me feel alive. My brother apparently felt otherwise.
A little longer, and together we could have defeated Lux and ruled the Demon Realm...
strings.이해할 수 없다는 표정을 지어도 어쩔 수 없어. 마족은 그런 삶이 전부지: You can look as uncomprehending as you like. That is all a demon's life holds. Those are the rules of the Demon Realm.
My brother refused those rules and ran away. He left no word of where he went. Not that I care to know.
strings.판데모니움을 배신한 존재는 누구를 막론하고 모두의 표적이 된다. 어디 갔: Anyone who betrays Pandemonium becomes everyone's target. Somehow, I became their outlet for anger in place of my missing brother...
strings.럭스에게 붙잡혀 리시테아의 문에 갇힐 줄이야. 하아…. 무슨 짓을 해도: Captured by Lux and imprisoned in the Gate of Lysithea. Haah... An eternal space that drags me back, whatever I do...
strings.그래서 럭스가 시킨 일을 한 거야?: So that's why you did what Lux asked?
strings.살아 남으려면 시키는 대로 해야지. 죽지 않아야 나중에라도 복수할 수 있: I have to obey to survive. I can't take revenge later if I'm dead.
strings.영원히 나갈 수 없는 장소라면서 어떻게?: How, if you can never leave this place?
A good question. Hehe. There is a way.
strings.(안드레아가 가볍게 미소 지으며 조용히 뒤로 물러난다. 그리고 두 팔을: (Andrea smiles faintly and steps back, spreading his arms to present the space around him.)
Someone who can find and open the keeper's door has arrived, after all.
strings.(많은 문이 세워져 있는 또 다른 공간, 그중에서 문 하나가 밝게 빛나고: (In this other space, lined with countless doors, one shines brightly.)
(Whether or not he notices the shining door, Andrea continues.)
strings.내가 너를 구속하면 리시테아가 기뻐할 거야. 마족인 나보다 신의 가호를: Lysithea will be pleased if I imprison you. This place suits someone blessed by a god far better than a demon like me...
strings.(춤을 추듯이 부드러운 안드레아의 손짓에 마력으로 타오르는 화살이 만들어: (With a graceful, almost dance-like gesture, Andrea forms an arrow blazing with magic. He nocks it to his red bow and aims at %s.)
strings.(%s도 안드레아의 행동이 무엇을 의미하는지 알기에 서둘러 경계 태세를: (Understanding Andrea's intent, %s hastily takes a defensive stance.)
strings.자, %s. 나를 대신해 이곳의 관리자가 되어다오. 그게 이곳에 들어온: Now, %s. Take my place as keeper. Such is your fate for entering this place...
strings.(지친 안드레아가 자신과 마찬가지로 지쳐있는 %s의 모습을 빤히 바라본다: (Exhausted, Andrea stares at the equally weary %s.)
Phew. You refuse to fall. All I need to do is lock you away once you're down...
strings.(이대로라면 승산이 없어. 어떻게 해야 하지? 잠깐, 저 문?): (I can't win like this. What do I do? Wait, that door...?)
strings.(왠지 저 문을 열어야 할 것 같은 기분이 드는데…. 그래, 일단 해보자: (Something tells me I need to open that door... All right. Let's try. Something will work out.)
Whatever you're thinking, there's nowhere to run.
strings.(안드레아가 한쪽 문을 향해 도망가려는 듯한 %s의 행동에 가볍게 웃는다: (Andrea chuckles as %s heads toward a door, apparently trying to escape. He forms an arrow larger than any before it.)
Let's end this. Your eternal imprisonment begins—
strings.(굳게 닫혀 있던 문 중 하나가 %s의 강한 공격에 부딪혀 열린다.): (%s's powerful strike forces open one of the tightly shut doors.)
Opening a sealed door won't let you escape me...
strings.(%s의 모습이 문으로 향한 순간, 안드레아의 손끝에 머물던 화살이 문으: (As %s moves toward the doorway, Andrea releases the arrow from his fingertips.)
strings.(잠시 후, 뭔가를 관통하는 커다란 소리가 문밖에 없는 공간에 울려 퍼진: (A moment later, a loud sound of piercing impact echoes through the space of doors.)
strings.(안드레아가 등 뒤에서 날아온 자신의 화살을 확인하고는 그대로 주저앉는다: (Andrea sees his own arrow protruding from his back and sinks to the ground.)
Not even my key could open that door... How did you... ?
