strings.(쿨럭거리며 쓰러진 안드레아의 뒤로 천천히 모험가가 걸어 나온다.): (The adventurer slowly emerges behind the fallen, coughing Andrea.)
Cough, cough. A god is helping you.
Either way, I'm taking your keys.
strings.(안드레아가 지그시 입술을 깨물며 열쇠 꾸러미를 손에 든 모험가를 바라본: (Andrea bites his lip, watching the adventurer hold the ring of keys.)
Do as you like... Cough, cough.
strings.그새 정신을 잃었네. 후우. 이 정도라면 금방 깨어나도 공격해 오진 않겠: Already unconscious. Phew. Even if he wakes up soon, he shouldn't be in any condition to attack...
strings.(모험가가 정신을 잃은 안드레아를 뒤로 한 채 주위를 둘러본다.): (Leaving the unconscious Andrea behind, the adventurer looks around.)
Haah. No choice. Tedious or not, I'll have to open them all...
strings.(열쇠 꾸러미에 있는 모든 열쇠로 보이는 문을 열어 보지만, 문 안쪽에는: (Trying every key, the adventurer opens all the visible doors. Beyond each is only an enclosed space. Sylphid is nowhere to be found.)
I've opened them all. Where is Sylphid? Huh...
strings.(그 순간, 방 안에서 처음으로 열었던 문틈으로 작은 새의 지저귐이 들려: (A small bird's chirp comes through the first door opened in this room. Light begins to shine around it.)
What is that door? Phew. Only one way to find out.
strings.(안으로 발을 내딛는 순간, 허공에서 떠 있던 별들이 소멸하듯 빛이 하나: (As the adventurer steps inside, the suspended starlike lights go out one by one. When the final light fades, the door slams shut behind them.)
strings.(알 수 없는 소리가 공간을 가득 채운다. 그 소리와 함께 사라졌던 빛이: (An unfamiliar sound fills the space. With it, the vanished light returns and illuminates someone.)
strings.(처음 보는 여성의 실루엣이 괴로워하면서 주저앉아 있다.): (The silhouette of an unfamiliar woman crouches in pain.)
strings.(기묘한 소리 가운데, 여성의 절규하는 목소리가 희미하게 섞여 들려오고: (Her anguished voice is faintly audible beneath the strange sound.)
strings.(여기는 어디지? 분명 문 안으로 들어왔는데, 그리고 저기 있는 사람은: (Where am I? I went through the door... Who is that? She's saying something, but I can barely hear...)
strings.(내 손은 어디에 있지? 내 얼굴은…? 내 발은…? 그리고 나는?): (Where are my hands? My face...? My feet...? Where am I?)
(As strange thoughts fill the mind, the eerie sound begins to disperse. The woman's voice gradually becomes clearer.)
I was always there, watching. I never betrayed life.
strings.나는 새로운 공간에 빛을 머물게 하고 싶었어. 그가 손을 대기 전에 하려: I wanted light to dwell in a new space. I tried to do it before he interfered...
strings.어째서… 터무니없는 혼돈과 어둠의 순간이 밀려온 거지?: Why... Why did such impossible chaos and darkness come rushing in?
strings.우리의 별은 필연적으로 만들어졌어. 그래서 절대로 우연으로 사라져서는 안: Our star came into being by necessity. It must never vanish by chance...
strings.함부로 내 이름을 부르지 마!!: Don't you dare speak my name!
strings.(리시테아라 불린 여성이 소리를 지르며 괴로워한다. 하지만, 리시테아를: (The woman called Lysithea cries out in pain. But the voice calling her will not stop.)
strings.생명이 사는 별은 낡고 더러운 그런 게 아니야. 당신이 지켜본 세계가 아: A star that shelters life is not something old and filthy. However far the world you've watched falls short of your standards, you cannot treat it this way!
strings.내가 사랑했던 ▒▒도, ▒▒▒도, ▒▒▒▒도 모두 죽었어. 모두 당신이: The ▒▒, ▒▒▒, and ▒▒▒▒ I loved are all dead. You killed them all.
strings.나는 살아서 당신과 싸우겠어. 비록 내가 만든 공간에 갇혀버렸고, 영원히: I will live and fight you. Even imprisoned in the space I created, even if I die trapped here for eternity.
strings.절대로 당신이 만든 뒤틀린 자라는 이름으로 살지 않아!!: I will never live under that name you made for me: the Twisted One!
strings.그래서 내게 제안하겠다고? 다시 태어나 제대로 된 신이 될 수 있게? 다: So you have an offer? A chance to be reborn as a proper god? I want to stand before those I love again, but not like that.
strings.내가 그 말을 믿을 것 같아?: Do you think I would believe you?
strings.아그니가 쓰러졌고, 세레스가 쫓겨났어. 가이아도 힘을 잃은 채 잠들어버렸: Agni has fallen. Seres was driven out. Gaia lost her power and fell asleep. Our beloved brothers and sisters are dead, and still you...!
strings.나는 살아야 해…. 살고 싶어…. 살아서 모두를 지켜야 해. 그러니까 날: I have to live... I want to live... I have to live and protect everyone. Stop tormenting me. Let me live...
strings.나는 아무 잘못도 하지 않았어…. 이 세계를 사랑한 게 죄라도 되는 거야: I've done nothing wrong... Is loving this world a crime... ?
strings.왜 계속 다른 이름으로 부르는 거야?: Why do you keep calling me by another name?
strings.(리시테아가 고개를 들어 어딘가를 응시한다.): (Lysithea raises her head and stares into the distance.)
I only have to accept the name Esnil? I don't understand.
The world must be purified to absolve all living beings of their sins...
strings.그러면 모두가 원하는, 아무도 고통받지 않는 세계가 온다는 건가?: Then the world everyone longs for will come? A world where no one suffers?
Then... Then perhaps becoming Esnil wouldn't be so—
strings.(그 순간, 리시테아의 실루엣 주위로 검은 그림자가 몰려들어 보이는 모든: (Black shadows suddenly gather around Lysithea's silhouette, swallowing everything in sight.)
strings.…잠자는 혼돈이여, 깊은 어둠에 깨어나 날 데려가지 마…. 이 세계는 당: ...O sleeping chaos, do not awaken in the deep darkness and take me away... This world is not yours.
strings.(그 말과 함께 실루엣을 비롯한 검은 그림자가 흩어진다. 그리고 더는 리: (With those words, the silhouette and black shadows disperse. Lysithea's voice is heard no more.)
strings.(그리고 세상에는 없던 강한 고통이 %s의 머릿속을 파고든다.): (Then pain beyond anything in this world tears into %s's mind.)
strings.찌르. 정신 차려라, %s. 내가 한 번 더 확 찌르…?: Chirp. Wake up, %s. Shall I give you another good peck—chirp?
strings.(%s의 앞에 작은 파랑새가 작은 날개를 퍼덕이며 다가와 공격하려는 자세: (A little bluebird flutters in front of %s, poised to strike.)
strings.찌르르. 깨어났구나. 다행이다. 깨어나지 않는 줄 알았다고!!: Chirp-chirp. You're awake! Thank goodness. I thought you weren't going to wake up!
strings.찌르. 나야 괜찮지만, 너는 괜찮은 거냐?: Chirp. I'm fine. What about you?
I am now, thanks to you.
strings.찌르르. 다행이다. 그런데 네가 어떻게 리시테아 님을 알고 있어?: Chirp-chirp. Good. But how do you know Lady Lysithea?
strings.찌르. 네가 쓰러진 채로 이상한 말을 중얼거렸어. 리시테아가 에스닐로 불: Chirp. You were muttering strange things while you were unconscious. That Lysithea hated being called Esnil.
strings.찌르르. 리시테아 님은 황혼 시대에 소멸했던 신이시고, 에스닐은 신들에게: Chirp-chirp. Lady Lysithea was a god who perished in the Twilight Era. Esnil was a Twisted One who cursed the gods and disappeared...
strings.(실피드에게 문을 열고 들어간 순간부터 리시테아의 실루엣을 본 것까지 모: (I tell Sylphid everything, from entering the door to seeing Lysithea's silhouette.)
Chirp-chirp... To think Lady Lysithea's memories remained here...
strings.리시테아라는 신께서 어떻게 된 걸까요?: What happened to the goddess Lysithea?
strings.찌르르. 잘 모르겠어. 이 공간이 리시테아 님의 기억을 보여주려 했던 거: Chirp-chirp. I don't know. If this space meant to show you her memories, there must be a reason.
strings.찌르. 리시테아 님에 관한 건 이리스 님만 알았으면 좋겠어. 아무래도 신: Chirp. Please tell only Iris about Lady Lysithea. It concerns the gods, after all.
Chirp-chirp. Just tell Nemo's children you found me safely.
Chirp. Let's leave, %s. Oh, bring that along.
strings.그런데 어디로 가죠? 닫힌 문을 다 열어서 이제 열 문도 없는데…. 왔던: But where do we go? I've opened every closed door. There's nothing left to open... Should we go back the way we came?
strings.찌르르. 그건 아니야, %s. 이곳이 리시테아 님의 공간이란 걸 안 이상: Chirp-chirp. No, %s. Now that we know this is Lady Lysithea's space, there's no reason for us to remain trapped.
strings.찌르. 생명을 사랑했던 분께서 생명이 고통받는 건 원치 않으실 거야. 후: Chirp. She loved life. She wouldn't want living beings to suffer. Hup!
strings.(참았던 숨을 내뱉은 실피드가 풍선처럼 부풀어 올라 거대해진다. 그리고는: (Sylphid releases his held breath and swells like a balloon, growing enormous. He lowers his head slightly.)
strings.(실피드가 어깨 위로 올라온 %s의 상태를 확인하고는 몸을 턴다. 그리고: (Once %s is settled on his shoulder, Sylphid shakes himself, raises his head, and charges off.)
strings.찌르르. 나가는 것도 나가는 건데, 지금 당장 할 일이 생겼어!: Chirp-chirp. We need to leave, but there's something we have to do first!
strings.(노토스와 제피로스가 굳게 닫힌 불길한 문에 얼굴을 댄 채 안에서 들려오: (Notos and Zephyros press their faces against the ominous closed gate, listening.)
strings.(누가 먼저랄 것도 없이 형제가 서로를 바라보고는 왔던 길로 서둘러 뛰어: (The brothers look at each other, then simultaneously turn and run back up the path.)
strings.(잠시 후, 문이 있던 자리에서 마치 막혀 있던 수맥이 터진 것 같은 커: (A moment later, a tremendous sound erupts from the gate, like a dammed underground river bursting free.)
strings.(문 안에서 터져 나온 게 그대로 땅으로 떨어지더니 곧장 제피로스와 노토: (Something bursts through the gate, lands on the ground, and rolls straight down the path after Zephyros and Notos.)
strings.제피로스, 뒤, 뒤를 돌아보지 마!! 엄청난 게 굴러오고 있다고!!: Zephyros, d-don't look back! Something huge is rolling after us!
strings.(협곡 하늘을 가득 채울 만큼 커다란 그림자가 노토스와 제피로스의 머리: (A shadow large enough to fill the canyon sky rises over the brothers, then engulfs them.)
Oh, Sylphid. I kept telling you to slow down, and now look...
strings.(몸집이 커진 실피드 아래 제피로스와 노토스가 사이좋게 깔려 있다.): (Zephyros and Notos lie side by side beneath the enlarged Sylphid.)
strings.…지금 정령왕 걱정할 때야? 이 무거운 털뭉치에 깔린 우리부터…. 어?: ...You're worried about the Spirit King? What about us, flattened under this heavy ball of feathers...? Huh?
Heavy? He's light as a feather.
strings.(노토스가 언제 나왔는지 실피드의 엉덩이에 깔려 있는 제피로스를 바라보고: (Already free, Notos looks down at Zephyros, still pinned beneath Sylphid's backside.)
Oh, you're right. I can breathe just fine.
strings.(제피로스가 노토스의 손을 붙잡고 실피드의 엉덩이 밑에서 기어 나온다.): (Zephyros takes Notos's hand and crawls out from beneath Sylphid.)
strings.보다시피 아무렇지도 않아. 그런데, 왜 문이 갑자기 닫힌 거지?: As you can see, I'm unharmed. But why did the gate suddenly close?
strings.(노토스와 제피로스에게 리시테아의 문 안에 있었던 이야기를 전한다. 실피: (I tell Notos and Zephyros what happened inside the Gate of Lysithea, leaving out the matter of Lysithea herself as Sylphid requested.)
strings.그런 일이 있었군요. 무사하셔서 다행입니다. 그 안에 그렇게 많은 사람과: So that's what happened. I'm glad you're safe. I had no idea so many people and spirits were imprisoned in there...
strings.그런데 왜 여기로 안 나오는 거야?: Why aren't they coming out here?
Chirp! I opened their doors and sent them all back where they belonged.
strings.(실피드가 정신을 차렸는지 작은 몸집이 되어 %s의 어깨에 앉는다.): (Having recovered his senses, Sylphid shrinks and settles on %s's shoulder.)
strings.흠? 문 안의 장소는 마계잖아. 그런데 어떻게 원래 있던 자리로 간 거지: Hmm? The place beyond that gate is in the Demon Realm. How did they return home? Is it connected to other places?
strings.찌르. 그렇게까지 물어봐도 나는 몰라. 정령왕이라고 세계의 깊숙한 부분까: Chirp. You can ask all you like, but I don't know. Even a Spirit King doesn't know every secret of the world.
Chirp-chirp. No. Most of the credit belongs to %s.
I only opened doors with a key...
strings.찌르르. 아, 관리자의 열쇠가 나오면서 사라졌구나. 어쨌든 마계의 물건이: Chirp-chirp. Oh, the keeper's keys vanished when we left. Of course. Things from the Demon Realm shouldn't come out here. Certainly not.
But Sylphid, the gate is still there...
strings.찌르. 걱정 마라. 문이 남아있어도, 여기는 내 구역이다. 나 정령왕 실: Chirp. Don't worry. The gate may remain, but this is my territory. I, Spirit King Sylphid, have taken care of it.
strings.(실피드가 어깨를 으쓱거리며 잘난척한다. 그러다 균형을 잃고 바닥으로 떨: (Sylphid puffs himself up proudly, then loses his balance. Notos catches him before he hits the ground.)
Chirp. I've made it so only %s and I can enter that gate. The demon inside won't be able to come out, either.
strings.(%s의 질문에 실컷 설명하던 실피드의 표정이 잠시 굳는다.): (Sylphid's animated expression briefly stiffens at %s's question.)
strings.찌르르. 그 나쁜 놈을 생각 못 했네. 불어오는 바람이 그러는데, 그놈은: Chirp-chirp. I forgot about that villain. The wind says he's left the canyon.
strings.찌르. 엥. 나가면 나간 건데, 뭔가 이상하네. 어디로 간 거지? 흔적도: Chirp. Huh. Leaving is one thing, but something's strange. Where did he go? He vanished without a trace...
strings.찌르르. 그래도 괜찮아. 이리스 님을 만났고, 내가 조금 쉬면 나중에 다: Chirp-chirp. Still, it's all right. I've met Iris, and once I've rested, I'll be strong enough to flatten that scoundrel if we meet again.
strings.찌르. 실핀이 협곡에 있는 마족들도 다 도망갔다고 하네. 그러니까 오늘의: Chirp. The Sylphins say all the demons in the canyon have fled, too. So today's trouble is over.
Today's trouble, yes. But the demons may come again someday...
Chirp-chirp. Nemo's children, I have something for you. Follow me to my resting place.
strings.(쉼터에 도착한 실피드가 힘차게 날갯짓하며 주위를 날아다닌다. 그러더니: (Back at his resting place, Sylphid flutters energetically around, ducks into a hiding place, then pops back into the air.)
strings.(실피드가 물고 있던 수첩을 세 사람 앞에 내려놓는다. 그리고 작은 날개: (Sylphid sets the notebook from his beak before them and brushes off the dust with his little wings.)
Chirp. Perhaps Nemo left this with me so I would meet you someday.
strings.찌르르. 언젠가 네모가 사람을 시켜 아무도 없는 너희 집 앞에 책을 보냈: Chirp-chirp. At some point, Nemo had someone deliver it to your empty house. It was addressed to 'My dear Sylphid.'
Chirp. He must have known I still visited the house from time to time.
strings.찌르르…. 네모의 아이들아. 내가 지금까지 이걸 가지고 있던 건 이유가: Chirp-chirp... Nemo's children. I've kept it all this time because I thought there must be a reason.
strings.찌르. 그런데 마법청? 그쪽의 방법으로 봉인이 되어 있어서 내가 볼 수: Chirp. But it was sealed with some Magic Bureau technique, so I couldn't read it. You might be able to open it. Here.
strings.(제피로스가 실피드가 준 수첩을 받아 봉인 방식을 확인한다.): (Zephyros takes the notebook from Sylphid and examines its seal.)
strings.(제피로스가 손을 뻗자 수첩에 걸려 있던 봉인이 풀렸는지 빛이 솟아올랐다: (Zephyros reaches out. Light flares from the notebook and fades as the seal breaks.)
strings.(그렇게 아버지의 수첩을 넘기며 보고 있던 두 형제의 얼굴이 점차 굳어져: (As the brothers turn the pages of their father's notebook, their expressions gradually harden.)
strings.아버지는 대체 뭘 본 거야? 제피로스. 내가 잘못 본 게 아니지? 잠깐,: What did Father see? Zephyros, I'm not misreading this, am I? Wait. Did you know, too?
A little... But nothing this detailed...
strings.찌르르, 네모의 아이들아. 거기 무슨 내용이 있어서 그렇게 질겁하는 거야: Chirp-chirp. Nemo's children, what's in there that's frightened you so? %s, read the notebook aloud.
strings.네, 실피드 님. 두분, 제가 잠깐 읽어도 될까요?: Yes, Sylphid. May I read it for a moment?
strings.(모험가가 망연자실한 표정으로 서있던 노토스와 제피로스에게 수첩을 받는다: (The adventurer takes the notebook from the stunned brothers.)
strings.(대체 뭐라고 쓰여 있기에 두 사람이 저러는 거야?): (What could it say to leave them like this?)
strings.「세계에 흐르는 기운을 빌려 생명의 삶을 윤택하게 만드는 방법 중 하나일: “It is one of the ways we borrow the energy flowing through the world to enrich the lives of living beings.”
strings.「제국은 그 방법인 마법으로 발전했고, 앞으로도 그 마법을 바탕으로 발전: “The Empire developed through magic, and will continue to develop upon that foundation.”
strings.「나는 그렇게 믿고 있다. 에레니스가 만든 마법 도구가 사람들을 도왔듯이: “I believe this. Just as Erenis's magical tools helped people, my research into wind, one of the elements...”
strings.「많은 사람들이 좀 더 나은 일상을 보내기 위해서다..」: “...Is meant to give more people a better everyday life.”
strings.「나는 모두가 행복하길 바라며 마법사가 됐고, 마법을 연구했다. 그리고: “I became a mage and studied magic because I wanted everyone to be happy. I entered the Magic Bureau because I wanted my children to be happy.”
strings.「마법청의 마법사들. 일부는 평범했고, 일부는 대범했다. 그리고 일부는: “The Bureau's mages. Some were ordinary. Some were bold. And some were mad.”
strings.「우연히 난 미친 마법사들의 세계를 보고 말았다. 그리고 그들은 내가 자: “By chance, I glimpsed the world of those mad mages. They wanted me to join them in it.”
strings.「대마법사 제레니스의 뜻을 따라 제국과 주민을 위해 일하는 마법사가 아닌: “To become a mage pursuing vile dreams, instead of serving the Empire and its people in the spirit of the archmage Jerenis.”
strings.「특권 의식을 가진 자들이 다른 인간과 모든 생명 위에 서는 세계. 그들: “A world where the entitled stand above other humans and all living things. They gathered power to bring about that world.”
strings.「그렇게 인간을 넘어서기 위해 모은 힘은….」: “And the power they gathered to transcend humanity was...”
strings.「신들이 사라진 세계를 위해 자신들만의 신을 만들어 세우려고 하는 것 같: “They seemed to intend to create and enthrone a god of their own, for a world from which the gods had vanished.”
strings.(실피드가 %s의 손에 있던 수첩을 빼앗아 노토스에게 던진다.): (Sylphid snatches the notebook from %s's hands and tosses it to Notos.)
'Above Glaston...' That seems to be where it ends.
strings.(제피로스와 노토스가 충격적인 내용 때문에 놀란 모험가를 붙잡고 다독인다: (Zephyros and Notos steady the adventurer, shaken by the horrifying contents, and offer reassurance.)
strings.(실피드가 %s의 머리 위로 날아올라 앉는다. 그러자 떨고 있는 %s의: (Sylphid flies up and settles on %s's head. The tension gradually leaves %s's trembling face.)
Thank you, Sylphid. I'm all right. You've helped me calm down.
strings.찌르르. 리시테아 님께서 내게 주신 선물이지. 날 아는 존재가 내 옆에: Chirp-chirp. A gift from Lady Lysithea. She made it so those who know me feel their worries ease when they're beside me. I can't really tell myself, though.
...So a Spirit King has this useful function, too.
Petting Sylphid certainly helped me feel better.
Then let me borrow you for a moment, too, Sylphid. Ah, that really is calming.
strings.(언제부터였는지 제피로스와 노토스의 손도 실피드의 날개를 어루만지고 있다: (At some point, Zephyros and Notos have also begun stroking Sylphid's wings.)
strings.이제 내부의 적들이 어떤 일을 하는지 알았으니까, 준비를 단단히 해야겠네: Now that we know what the enemy within is doing, we need to prepare carefully.
Enemies within and without... The outside enemy would be the Demon Realm, of course.
strings.네, 맞아요. 그리고 정확하게는 내부의 적이 계속해서 외부의 적을 부르고: Yes. More precisely, the enemy within keeps calling the outside enemy here.
strings.보통은 마계에서 이곳과 연결하려는 시도를 하지만, 최근엔 우리가 사는 이: Usually, the Demon Realm tries to connect to us. But lately, those attempts have been coming from our own star.
strings.찌르르. 일단 마계의 문 같은 건 내가 찾아서 여신님께 알려드리겠다. 그: Chirp-chirp. I'll look for gates to the Demon Realm and tell the goddess. Then you'll know, too.
strings.찌르. 나는 성계신님이 계셔야 더 멀리 날 수 있어. %s, 네가 협곡에: Chirp. With the God of the Astral Realm here, I can fly farther. If you hadn't come to the canyon, %s, I would never have met Iris or even greeted her.
I'm glad we can count on you.
strings.이 수첩으로 조금 더 확신하게 됐다. 아버지가 사고로 돌아가신 게 아니라: This notebook makes me more certain. Father's death wasn't an accident...
Notos, I need to return to the Magic Bureau and dig deeper into what they're doing.
No. We've only just reunited. Neither Chloris nor I will allow it.
But someone has to do it.
strings.그래, 누군가는 해야 하는 일이지. 이번엔 내게 맡겨라. 나도 마법청 출: Yes, someone does. Let me handle it this time. I was with the Bureau, too. I'll find a way...
strings.(그런 그때, 실피드가 하늘을 바라보더니 떠올라 노토스와 제피로스의 머리: (Sylphid looks up at the sky, then flies over and pecks Notos and Zephyros on the head in turn.)
strings.찌르르. 네모의 아이들아. 너희들이 싸우는 걸 네모와 에레니스가 알면 슬: Chirp-chirp. Nemo's children. Nemo and Erenis would be sad to see you fighting.
strings.찌르. 너희들이 적의 소굴로 스스로 들어가는 것도 방법이지만, 추천하고: Chirp. Walking into the enemy's den yourselves is one option. But I wouldn't recommend it.
strings.그래서 무슨 방법이라도 있는 건가?: Then do you have another idea?
strings.(실피드가 날갯짓을 하자 노토스의 품에 있던 정령석이 빛나기 시작한다.): (As Sylphid flaps his wings, the spirit stone tucked against Notos's chest begins to glow.)
Chirp. Toss the stone into the air.
strings.(노토스가 정령석을 꺼내 허공으로 던지자 실피드가 작은 날개를 들어 휘두: (Notos takes out the stone and tosses it up. Sylphid sweeps a small wing, splitting it in two. One piece falls before each brother.)
Chirp. Two pieces. Take one each and get along.
Sylphid, why did you break the stone... ?
strings.찌르르. 언제나 이걸 가지고 돌아다녀라. 전부는 아니겠지만, 가려져서 보: Chirp-chirp. Keep these with you wherever you go. They'll let you enter most concealed places. Not every one, but most.
Chirp. That's the beauty of wind's power.
strings.찌르르. 내가 너희들을 축복한 이상 끝까지 돌봐줘야 네모와 에레니스도 안: Chirp-chirp. Having blessed you, I must look after you to the end. Only then can Nemo and Erenis rest easy.
strings.찌르. 이런 걸 가지고 뭘. 그러니까 위험한 일은 적당히 해. 알았지?: Chirp. It's nothing. Just don't take too many risks, all right?
Of course, Sylphid. How can we ever repay you... ?
strings.찌르. 날 진짜 새로 보는 거야? 그런 건 됐고. 협곡에 없는 견과류가: Chirp. Do you think I'm an actual bird? Never mind that. Bring me nuts we don't have in the canyon. I liked the almonds Erenis gave me.
strings.(보기 좋아 보여….): (It's good to see them like this...)
strings.찌르. 두 사람 보내고 할 이야기가 있어. 네모의 아이들아. 너희들에게는: Chirp. There's something I want to discuss once these two leave. Forgive me, Nemo's children. I can't share this with you.
We'll head back to the house, then.
strings.찌르르. 나중에 날 보러 올 거면 내가 쉬는 곳으로 와. 언제든지 반갑게: Chirp-chirp. If you want to visit, come to my resting place. You'll always be welcome.
%s, Sylphid. Until next time. Thank you for today.
%s, Sylphid. Thanks to you, I think I'll remember this day forever.
strings.(노토스와 제피로스가 실피드와 %s에게 고마움을 표하고, 어린 시절 추억: (Notos and Zephyros thank Sylphid and %s, then return to the house filled with memories of their childhood.)
strings.실피드 님, 하실 말씀이 뭐죠?: What did you want to tell me, Sylphid?
strings.(실피드가 %s의 머리 위로 날아올라 앉고는 몸을 턴다. 그러자 앞으로: (Sylphid flies onto %s's head and shakes himself. Something drops in front of them.)
strings.찌르. 내가 문 안에 갇혔을 때, 발견해서 일단 챙겨뒀지. 거기 네 이름: Chirp. I found this while I was trapped behind that door and kept it. Your name was written on it.
strings.찌르르. 럭스의 힘 같은 게 느껴지긴 하지만, 내가 대충 정화해서 네가: Chirp-chirp. It had a trace of Lux's power, but I've purified it enough that you can touch it safely. What is it?
An edict sealed by the empress. Why was it there... ?
strings.찌르. 예언의 능력이 있는 어린 황제 말하는 거지? 10년 동안 많이 자: Chirp. The young empress with the gift of prophecy? She must have grown a lot in ten years. Read it. What does it say?
strings.「원래는 정식으로 전달해야 할 편지지만, 우리 모두를 방해하는 자를 위해: “This letter should have been delivered through official channels. However, I have prepared a small trap for the one who obstructs us all.”
strings.「제대로 %s 님께 도착할 수도 있지만, 의외의 곳에서 발견될 수도 있습: “It may reach you normally, %s, or you may find it somewhere unexpected. If it is discovered within the Demon Realm...”
strings.「그 방해자가 가져다 놓은 것입니다. 그 방해자의 이름은 아론, 아론 티: “...That obstructing party placed it there. His name is Aaron. Aaron Tienes.”
strings.「럭스의 그림자 역할을 하는 자입니다. 그리고 이 편지를 보신다면 데이나: “He acts as Lux's shadow. If you read this letter, please inform Dayna.”
strings.찌르르. 럭스의 그림자? 그럼 마족이 인간 흉내를 내면서 살고 있었던 거: Chirp-chirp. Lux's shadow? A demon was living among humans in disguise?
strings.그것까지는 잘 모르겠어요. 일단 보통 인간이 아니란 건 알고 있었지만요…: I don't know that much. I did know he wasn't an ordinary human...
I need to speak with Dayna.
Chirp. Where is this Dayna? I'll send you to her.
You can send me to Esnil? Oh... Esnil.
strings.찌르르. 그 이름이 있는 동네구나. 길드연합이라고 불리는 곳이지? 실핀이: Chirp-chirp. The town with that name. The Guild Union, right? The Sylphins like it there. An elf called Jelic feeds them well.
strings.거기 맞아요. 사람, 새 따지지 않고 먹을 걸 잘 주는 멋진 엘프가 있는: That's the place. It has a wonderful elf who feeds everyone, human or bird.
strings.찌르. 내가 그쪽으로 보내줄게. 바람의 정령왕이 힘을 왕 쓰면 너 하나쯤: Chirp. I'll send you there. With a little royal effort, the Wind Spirit King can whisk one human from west to east without trouble.
strings.찌르르. 이번에 정말 정말 고마웠어. 그리고 더 강해져서 나중엔 내가 제: Chirp-chirp. Thank you so, so much for everything. I'll grow stronger and give you proper help next time. It was good to meet you, %s. See you again.
It was good to meet you, too, Sylphid. Until next time.
strings.(실피드가 바닥에 앉더니 작은 날갯짓을 한다. 그러자 어디선가 작은 나뭇: (Sylphid settles on the ground and gives his small wings a flutter. Leaves gather on a warm breeze and wrap around %s.)
strings.(그렇게 다가온 따뜻한 바람은 모험가를 실어 어딘가로 날려 보낸다.): (The warm wind lifts the adventurer and carries them away.)
strings.(%s의 주위를 맴돌던 나뭇잎이 사라진다. 그 사이로 짙은 그림자가 드리: (The leaves circling %s vanish. Deep shadows fall between them, revealing an unfamiliar side of Esnil.)
strings.(데이나가 잡았던 %s의 손을 당겨 바닥에 내려올 수 있게 한다.): (Dayna pulls gently on %s's hand, helping them down to the ground.)
strings.%s 씨에게서 따뜻한 바람이 느껴지네? 그런데 여기 어떻게 온 거야?: There's a warm breeze around you, %s. How did you get here?
strings.여기는 에스닐의 이면이야. 아는 사람만 오고 갈 수 있는 그런 장소. 오: This is Esnil's Other Side. Only those who know of it can come and go. They can enter only through me.
strings.그런데, 언제 내가 데려왔었나?: But when did I bring you here?
Good question. I do feel as though I've been here before.
strings.날 찾아온 거 맞지?: You came to see me, right?
strings.네, 맞아요. 이야기가 좀 긴데, 시간 괜찮아요?: Yes. It's a long story. Do you have time?
Of course. I'm meeting someone here anyway. Someone you know, %s.
strings.아, 그러셨구나. 네? 설마, 폐하예요?: Oh, I see. Wait... Her Majesty?
My sister again... Haah. Well, never mind. Your story first.
strings.(데이나에게 바유나 협곡에서 있었던 일을 모두 이야기한다.): (I tell Dayna everything that happened in Vayuna Canyon.)
strings.…그런 일이 있었군. 바랄이라는 남자, 이스트랜드에서도 바이스의 일을 돕: ...So that's what happened. We'd been watching Baral. He helped Weiss in Eastland and even visited the Demon Realm.
I had Licota follow him, but he suddenly vanished. Hearing your story, %s, I think I understand now.
If he went to the Demon Realm then, too, it makes sense. And Aaron...
strings.우리는 다들 아론이 마족을 위해 일하는 추종자라고 판단했는데, 언니의 편: We all thought Aaron was a human follower working for demons. My sister's letter makes it clear we were completely wrong.
If Aaron is a demon himself, it all fits...
strings.잘난 마법사들은 잘난 능력을 넘어서고 싶을 뿐이고, 아론은 그들을 이용하: Those arrogant mages want to surpass even their own vaunted abilities, and Aaron is using them.
But who wants this new god? Haah...
We're all going to be even busier, %s.
I'll help however I can, Dayna.
strings.우리는 우리의 일을 할 테니까, %s 씨는 %s 씨만의 일을 해. 그게: We'll do our work, %s. You do the work only you can do, %s. That's how it should be.
strings.아, %s 씨. 언니가 곧 올 때가 돼서 잠깐 나갔다 올게. 조금 기다려: Oh, %s. My sister should be arriving soon. I'll step out to meet her. Wait here a moment.
strings.(그때, 에스닐의 이면을 덮고 있던 짙은 그림자 사이에서 누군가 천천히: (Someone slowly approaches through the deep shadows covering Esnil's Other Side.)
strings.(그림자가 조금씩 사라지자 제국에 있는 어떤 누구보다 고귀한 여성이 두: (As the shadows recede, the Empire's most exalted woman waves to them.)
Sister? How did you get here...? I said I'd come to meet you.
strings.미안해. 마냥 기다리고만 있을 수 없어서…. 잘 지냈어요, %s?: I'm sorry. I couldn't just keep waiting... Have you been well, %s?
Sister, this isn't somewhere just anyone can discover or enter...
Your Majesty, what are you trying to say... ?
strings.(데이나가 카이나의 표정에서 뭔가 읽었는지 등을 돌린다. 그리고 서둘러: (Reading something in Kaina's face, Dayna turns away and hurries off in the opposite direction.)
strings.(뒤따라가지만, 이미 데이나는 에스닐의 이면에서 나간 것 같다. 그렇게: (They follow, but Dayna seems to have already left Esnil's Other Side. Only Kaina and %s remain.)
strings.%s, 데이나하고는 제가 나중에 이야기할게요. 제 이야기를 들어주시겠어요: I'll speak to Dayna later, %s. Will you hear me out?
strings.언제부턴지는 알 수 없지만, 실바리아 황족들은 보통 사람들에겐 없는 특별: I don't know when it began, but members of the Silvaria imperial family sometimes develop unusual gifts.
strings.아주 드물게 나타나긴 했지만, 그게 황족이 일반 주민들보다는 내세울 수: Rare as they are, those gifts have always distinguished us from ordinary citizens.
strings.고모할머님은 특별한 유물을 찾아내는 재능이 있으셨고, 막내 시이나는 어떤: Our great-aunt has a gift for finding special relics. Our youngest sister, Shiina, has a greater talent for magic than any other royal.
strings.저와 데이나에겐 그런 특별한 재능이 따로 없었지만, 괜찮았어요. 하루하루: Dayna and I had no such special gifts, but that was all right. We lived our lives happily enough.
strings.그러나, 10년 전 일이 모든 걸 바꿔놓았어요. 어느 순간부터 전 예지의: Then what happened ten years ago changed everything. At some point, I became aware of my foresight, and Dayna began to walk the Other Side.
strings.시작은 사소한 것들이었지만, 시간이 흐르면서 좀 더 많은 걸 보게 됐어요: At first, I saw only small things. As time passed, I began to see more.
strings.(그 순간, 카이나의 눈이 반짝거린다. 잠시 후, 두 사람 앞에 형체가: (Kaina's eyes flash. A moment later, a large, distinct apparition forms before them.)
strings.(어? 거울? 시계? 저게 뭐지?): (Huh? A mirror? A clock? What is that?)
My ability isn't a special gift of the imperial family...
strings.(거울의 환영 위에 있는 시침과 분침이 갑자기 빠른 속도로 돌아가기 시작: (The hour and minute hands on the spectral mirror suddenly spin rapidly. Unknown scenes flash across its surface.)
strings.검은 달의 여신께서 퍼뜨린 힘이 프레이오스에 떨어져 여러 형태로 반영된: The power scattered by the Goddess of the Black Moon fell upon Freios and manifested in different forms...
At some point, it awakened within me...
strings.이 힘은, 이 능력은 온전히 제것이라 생각했는데, 그게 아니었나봐요. %: I thought this power, this ability, was entirely my own. But perhaps it wasn't. %s, I'm afraid...
...I want to run, but I can't...
strings.(카이나가 %s에게 다가가 두손을 붙잡는다.): (Kaina approaches %s and takes both their hands.)
strings.(그 순간, 거울 환영 위에 있던 시침과 분침이 멈춘다. 그 뒤로 빠르게: (The hands on the spectral mirror stop. The rushing scenes behind them become still, revealing a single vision.)
What you see is my own future. The future I keep seeing...
For everyone's sake, I have to escape it. And if I can't, then at least I must...
strings.(혼란에 빠진 것 같은 카이나의 정신을 반영하듯 다시 거울 환영에 있던: (As though reflecting Kaina's turmoil, the mirror's hands spin rapidly again. Then, at a certain point, it bursts with a deafening crash.)
strings.폐하? 폐하!! 괜찮으세요?: Your Majesty? Your Majesty! Are you all right?
strings.(고통스러워하는 카이나에게 다가가려 하는 순간, 언제 들어왔는지 데이나가: (As the adventurer moves toward the suffering Kaina, Dayna suddenly appears and blocks the way.)
strings.%s 씨, 언니는 내가 챙길게. 언니는 정신을 잃은 것뿐이야. 괜찮을 거: %s, I'll take care of my sister. She's only lost consciousness. She'll be all right... She will...
Go outside for now. Wait there...
strings.(데이나가 길드연합 본부 건물 안에서 천천히 걸어나온다. 평소보다 무리했: (Dayna slowly emerges from the Guild Union headquarters, limping slightly as though she has pushed herself too hard.)
strings.언니는 괜찮아. 약 먹고 잠들었어…. 아르젠트에게 연락했으니까 깨어나는: She's all right. She took some medicine and fell asleep... I've contacted Argent. He'll take her back to the palace when she wakes.
The future she was trying to change? Please, tell me.
All right... What Her Majesty and I saw was...
strings.나도, 언니도 10년 전 도망가고 있었던 마냥 어린 소녀가 아니야. 이제: My sister and I aren't the little girls who ran away ten years ago. We're adults now. We can't keep running.
strings.그리고 무거워진 어깨만큼 더 최선을 다해야겠지. 그걸 떠나서 황족의 의무: The heavier our responsibilities, the harder we must try. And we still have our duties as members of the imperial family.
She always tries to carry everything alone... Haah...
strings.%s 씨, 그러면 그때 보자. 오늘은 좀 쉬고…. 먼 곳에서 와서 힘들잖: Then I'll see you when the time comes, %s. Get some rest today. You've come a long way... We'll meet in Glaston soon.
All right... You rest, too, Dayna.
strings.(데이나가 가볍게 웃으며 천천히 길드연합 본부 안으로 들어간다.): (Dayna gives a small smile and slowly returns to the Guild Union headquarters.)
Now the exhaustion's catching up with me. I should rest, too...
strings.(조금 전 봤던 게 아직도 머릿속에서 떠올라…….): (I can't get that vision out of my mind...)
strings.(카이나와 %s, 두 사람이 거울의 환영 속에서 봤던 건 바로….): (What Kaina and %s saw in the spectral mirror was...)
strings.(거대한 도시가 불바다가 된 가운데, 두 사람이 누군가에 의해 고통스럽게: (A vast city engulfed in flames. The two of them dying in agony at someone's hands. And approaching them, a being who had become a god...)
